items.statement: Resin prices stabilizing after March-April volatility; expect gradual decline over 3-6 months if Hormuz situation clears
items.quote: It is comparatively much more stabilized as compared to what was there in the month of March and April. Now once the war and the Hormuz situation is clear, then we expect the prices to slowly gradually come down.

items.statement: XLPE capacity increased to 214,500 MTPA with Bhiwadi commissioning; XLPE to drive growth with 72% mix
items.quote: With this addition, our installed XLPE capacity has increased to 2,14,500 metric tons per annum, further consolidating our leadership in the important product category.

items.statement: Bhiwadi facility running at 20-25% utilization; targeting 50% average for FY27, contributing INR200-250 crores revenue
items.quote: As of now, it is running at roughly 20%, 25-odd percent. And slowly, it will get ramped up over a period of time. So by end of this year, we consider 50% average utilization for this year.

items.statement: Topline ambition of INR5,000 crores by FY30 supported by structural drivers
items.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our top line ambition of INR5,000 crores by FY '30.

items.statement: Cash conversion cycle temporarily increased in Q1; expect normalization to 55-60 days range
items.quote: Now it has again consolidated and it is coming down, and we expect it to be in the range of 55 to 60 days as we originally see on a regular basis.

items.statement: Management declined to provide specific revenue or volume guidance for FY27 due to geopolitical uncertainties
items.quote: I don't want to put a specific number because there are a lot of global uncertainties still placed. And also, you know, the impacts which have come across in our industry. So, it would not be certain, it would not be to give any specific numbers at this point of time.

items.statement: No new capex plans disclosed; focus on utilizing existing 1.14 million sqm capacity across India and Dubai
items.quote: With 1.14 million square meter per annum of combined annual production capacity across India and Dubai, 95% of our revenue derived from exports, GSL has built a strong global manufacturing and distribution footprint.

items.statement: Company reports strong order book but no specific value disclosed
items.quote: we do have a strong order book with us

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 12.69% from loss previous quarter; management expects dramatic profitability scale-up with higher utilization
items.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 8 crores compared to an EBITDA loss of Rs. 19 crores in the previous quarter, with EBITDA margins improving to 12.69% profit after tax also turned positive, improving from a loss of Rs. 2 crores in the previous quarter to break-even during this quarter.

items.statement: Able to pass on 30-40% of freight cost increases to customers; freight costs remain exorbitantly high
items.quote: we've been able to pass on about 30-40% of the increase in cost to most of our customers who have been very cooperative in absorbing the increase during the last quarter.

items.statement: Product demand remains stable and strong despite tariff and geopolitical uncertainties
items.quote: No, there has been no major change in product demand. The product demand still remains very stable and strong.

items.statement: Launched patented Marquartz technology; planning India domestic launch in Q2 FY27 with differentiated designs
items.quote: We also made progress in the value-added products portfolio with the successful launch of Marquartz Technology, our proprietary patented innovation, strengthening our positioning in the premium engineered surface and supporting better value realizations.

items.statement: US Section 201 safeguard investigation on quartz surfaces creates near-term uncertainty; recommended 25% in-quota and 50% above-quota tariffs
items.quote: The US International Trade Commission determined the increased imports of Quartz surfaces products were a substantial cause of serious injury to the domestic industry. The commission subsequently recommended a four-year trade tariff quota with 25% in the quota tariff and 50% above quota tariff in the first year.

items.statement: Discontinued Bagru natural stone unit (loss of Rs 7-8 cr on Rs 12-14 cr revenue); asset disposal expected within FY27
items.quote: last year from our unit one, we had a loss, which was about 7 to 8 crores. And the top line for that unit was somewhere around 12 crores or 14 crores. So, it was an operational loss facility for us.

items.statement: Dubai facility EBITDA positive in FY26 and Q1 FY27; loan-to-equity conversion completed to strengthen balance sheet
items.quote: The Dubai unit was EBITDA positive even in June 26. And it was EBITDA positive during the last financial year as well.

items.statement: Expanding India sales team from 9-10 to 25-30 people; adding ~15 people for domestic market
items.quote: we do see that over the next quarter, we will be expanding the sales and marketing team to almost 25 to 30 people in totality.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance maintained at 18-20% for FY27 despite Q1 41% YoY growth
items.quote: So, I would stick to the guidance that we had given during quarter 4, which was close to around 18%-20% of growth in the revenue.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 at 13-14% despite geopolitical headwinds
items.quote: And then on the group level also, even during the last quarter, when someone was asking me about the EBITDA for the next year, I told them that it is going to be around 13%-14% where we are in line with what we had thought of.

items.statement: Capex for FY27 at Rs 20-25 crore, mostly for Tower 3 completion
items.quote: So, CAPEX spending is, I think, somewhere close to around Rs. 20-25 crores, not much of the CAPEX is left.

items.statement: ODM home lighting dependency reduced from ~60% to <20% of revenue over 3 years
items.quote: So, from around 60% to now, somewhere close to around less than 20%. So, that is the kind of change that has happened.

items.statement: ODM home lighting FY27 revenue expected at ~Rs 170 crore (+/- Rs 10-15 crore)
items.quote: Broadly 170. Give or take maybe an uptick of Rs. 10-15 crores is probably on the charts, but we will see how it goes.

items.statement: Hearables & wearables now 15-18% of revenue with 50% ODM products, production visibility 3-6 months
items.quote: If I talk of, the overall top line, we are doing somewhere close to around, maybe around 15% to 18%, it's around 15%-16% is coming from hearable wearable.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions causing raw material volatility, semiconductor shortages, and spot buying like COVID era
items.quote: The problem with the gross margins today is we are in times which I would say is similar to what happened during COVID because lead times have gone up like anything.

items.statement: ODM segment EBITDA margin ~8.4% in Q1 FY27, other business ~15% EBITDA margin
items.quote: So, the EBITDA margin that you see in ODM, which is somewhere close to around, if I look at the Quarter 1, there has been an improvement so which is somewhere close to around 8.4%.

items.statement: FY27 is a critical year shifting from building to monetizing the platform; standalone revenue and profit more than doubled YoY with margin expansion
items.quote: FY '27 is a critical year for us where this agenda of building is shifting decisively towards monetizing this platform.

items.statement: Qualified pipeline at $80.13 million end of Q1; added $20.4 million new pipeline vs $15.27 million converted; 70% non-SCF and 70% international
items.quote: We opened with a 79.62 million pipeline. We added 20.4 million to the pipeline this quarter. That is what we added. We converted 15.27 out of 79.62.

items.statement: Revenue shifting to platform deals: 74% recurring revenue, 77% from existing clients; cross-sell validated with 6-product and 3-product wins
items.quote: In the revenues, recurring is 74%. So from existing clients, our recurring revenue is 74% here. Onetime revenue is 26%.

items.statement: Capex cycle largely over; Rs 50-60 crore debt raised for working capital gaps due to chunky revenue recognition vs constant spends
items.quote: Our CAPEX cycle this year is much lower than last year. However, we still require these working capital funds because what I will end the year at versus what my quarter 1 is, is not same.

items.statement: Amalgamation at final NCLT stage (5 of 7 steps done); filing second motion petition in 2-3 days; promoter shares pledged for debt with EBITDA 3x and DSCR 1.25x covenants
items.quote: We are filing the NCLT petition, which is second motion. We are filing it anytime right now, over the next 2-3 days.

items.statement: PSB Xchange lender integrations slow: 3 live, 7 in progress, 22 not started due to bank bandwidth and legacy systems; inflection expected at 10-12 banks
items.quote: The day we have 10-12 banks integrated on the platform that is the inflection point.

items.statement: Raised Rs 50-60 crore debt at 14-15% for 2-3 years; promoters pledged shares; plan to retire debt early; no equity dilution at current pricing
items.quote: We have taken the risk of pledging our shares because we believe in what we are doing. And based on that, we have allowed, we have taken the decision of going in for a debt.

items.statement: Aspires to open 150 stores in FY27; 33 opened in Q1
items.quote: we have aspirations to open 150 stores by the end of the financial year

items.statement: Targets to continue same growth trajectory as last 3-4 years
items.quote: we are very hopeful that we will continue the same growth story which we have been doing in the last 3 years, 4 years

items.statement: Aspires to maintain EBITDA margin around 20% for FY27
items.quote: We would like to remain as it is now. We'd like to be stable

items.statement: Opened 33 new stores in Q1 FY27; mix of 800-1,500 sq ft stores in South, East, West
items.quote: we have opened 33 stores this quarter

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 47.5%, EBITDA margin 20.4%, PAT INR47 cr (+19.4% YoY)

items.statement: No price increases taken; absorbing cost inflation via sourcing and supply chain efficiencies
items.quote: we have not increased our prices. So we are we are trying to bring in efficiencies rather than resort to -- which is the easy way out, I think increasing prices

items.statement: Core India retail demand improved through Q1 after soft start; e-commerce revenue declined due to disciplined discounting
items.quote: After some softness in the early part of the quarter, the core India retail business saw improving trends and continued to perform well overall

items.statement: Income tax search proceedings ongoing; no material claim or risk identified so far
items.quote: as of now there's been no claim of any material and there's no risk of any material

items.statement: Acquired Sprandi brand rights for India and neighboring countries; launch by end-September 2026, starting with footwear

items.statement: E-commerce share fell to 22% in Q1 from 30% due to avoiding deep discounting; aspires to return to 30% share
items.quote: The aspiration is there to that e-commerce remains at the 30% level, it has always and that the scale it has always been within our turnover

items.statement: Inventory days at 173, targeting 150 days; seasonal build-up expected in Q2
items.quote: It is now 173 days and we are targeting to reduce it to 150

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 guidance, will reassess next quarter
items.quote: I think it's a tough year. At this point, I would not like to guide for anything. I think we will have to see how things improve in the next quarter.

items.statement: FY27 capex limited to maintenance plus a few steel bottle lines; new lines to commission early next year
items.quote: I think CAPEX plan, there is nothing major coming in this year. It's only going to be maintenance kind of CAPEX that we would be maintaining. Having said that, there could be an addition of a few lines in the steel segment, which we will plan soon.

items.statement: Glassware plant peak revenue potential Rs 250-275 cr; Steelware plant peak Rs 300 cr with 8 lines
items.quote: At peak, glass would be at about 250 to 275 crores revenue, which is from the plant, of course. And then we have other Allied products as well. And at peak, Steelware plant currently with eight lines should be at about 300 crores.

items.statement: Consumer Ware gross margin expected to stabilize in 54-55% band and improve sequentially
items.quote: Yes, you should see that constantly. It should be improving rather, I would say.

items.statement: Price hikes of 7-20% across categories implemented; overall average ~12-13%; 90% impact visible in Q1
items.quote: Starting from 7% to almost 20%. So, the price actually has been quite significant. And that is one of the reasons also why volumes have dropped in this particular quarter.

items.statement: Consumer demand subdued due to inflation and macro uncertainty; channel inventory corrected, secondary sales improved
items.quote: Consumer demand continued to remain subdued as discretionary spending was impacted by inflationary pressures and the prevailing macroeconomic uncertainties.

items.statement: Steel bottle in-house manufacturing at 8 lines, 20-25 SKUs vs 150 earlier; ramping to 50-55 SKUs over next couple of quarters
items.quote: We are at only about 20-25 products currently. And we used to play in around 150-odd SKUs. I think we will of course reach 50-55 SKUs which were contributing our major sale.

items.statement: E-commerce channel contribution rose to 16.3% of revenue from 10.4% in Q1 FY26 with profitability in line with general trade
items.quote: The online channel increased its contribution to 16.3% from the 10.4% in Q1 FY26, with profitability remaining in line with the general trade channel.

items.statement: No promoter stake sale; clarification already issued to exchanges
items.quote: There has been a clarification that has already been put out. I think you can refer to that. And currently, there is no other comment on this that we would like to make.

items.statement: Marketing spend maintained at 2.5-3% of revenue; focus on digital and in-shop over above-the-line
items.quote: I think we have always maintained about 2.5% to 3% as advertisement marketing cost. And that continues to be the case even in this quarter.

items.statement: Wim Plast merger share allotment delayed due to technical glitches; expected completion in few weeks
items.quote: We have not completed the allotment of the shares because of some technical glitches we are facing. Maybe in the few weeks, we will complete that process.

items.statement: Reiterated FY27 guidance: branch addition 40-45, spreads >6%, credit cost 40-50bps, loan growth 25-30%
items.quote: On that note, let me re-iterate the guidance for FY27: Branch addition of around 40-45 for the year, Maintain spreads of more than 6% in the medium term, Credit Cost of around 40-50bps, Loan growth of around 25-30%

items.statement: Confident of achieving 25-30% AUM growth despite Q1 accounting change impact
items.quote: However, we are confident of catching up the growth in remaining 9 months and retaining our AUM growth guidance at 25% to 30% this year.

items.statement: Expect disbursement growth to cross 20% mark; July disbursement at Rs 400 cr under new methodology
items.quote: July we have done around Rs. 400 Crs of disbursement in fact under the cheque realization methodology. And if we continue to maintain this trend, which we are quite confident about, I think we should be in position to cross 20% mark in disbursement growth.

items.statement: Portfolio yield stable at 14.8% QoQ; incremental disbursement yield at 14.9% (+20-30bps vs Q4); finance cost stable at 8.2%; marginal cost of funds at 7.9%
items.quote: Our portfolio yield is 14.8%, stable quarter-on-quarter basis. Our quarter 1 disbursement yield was at 14.9%... Finance cost is stable at 8.2% on quarter-on-quarter basis. Our marginal cost of fund is also stable at 7.9% quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Expect limited 10bps impact on cost of funds in H2; spreads >6% maintained via incremental pricing
items.quote: But we expect that the overall impact on the cost of fund will remain limited to 10 basis point. Keeping that in mind, we have already started passing on the, like, incremental disbursement.

items.statement: Stage 3 at 1.5% (+30bps QoQ); expect stabilization in Q2 and recovery from Q3; credit cost guidance 40-50bps maintained
items.quote: We expect Asset Quality to stabilize around similar levels at the end of Q2FY27 and expect recovery from Q3FY27 onwards.

items.statement: Passed on 10bps benefit to variable-rate customers in Q4; no PLR change as blended cost stable; incremental disbursement yields raised 20-30bps
items.quote: In fact we have passed on the benefit of about 10 basis point in Q4 to our existing variable rate customers. Since there is no change in our blended cost of fund, there is no change in the PLR.

items.statement: Home loans 57% of AUM/disbursements; LAP 43%; GNPA similar: HL 1.48%, LAP 1.52%; LAP LTV ~45%
items.quote: Our home loan ratio is about -- as a percentage of AUM is close to 57% and it is stable year-on-year basis. And if you look at the GNPA number between home loan and LAP, it is pretty much similar.

items.statement: Liquidity >Rs 800 cr; undrawn sanctions >Rs 1,500 cr; ALM positive all buckets; NHB funding 15% (+230bps YoY); avg borrowing tenure >8 years
items.quote: On liquidity side, we are comfortably placed with liquidity of more than INR 800 crores and undrawn sanction of more than INR 1,500 crores. Our ALM is positive across all the buckets.

items.statement: Reiterated long-term annual revenue growth guidance of over 25% while maintaining industry-leading profitability profile
items.quote: We proudly reiterate our long -term annual revenue growth guidance of over 25%, while maintaining our stellar industry-leading profitability profile.

items.statement: Advised to prepare for significant scale-up in production volumes for indigenous turbojet engine after testing completion
items.quote: We have also been advised to prepare for a significant scale -up in production volumes once the ongoing sequence of testing is completed.

items.statement: Successfully delivered India's first indigenous turbojet engine to DRDO, evolving from component manufacturer to integrated propulsion system player
items.quote: Azad Engineering has successfully manufactured, assembled and delivered India's first indigenous expendable turbojet engine to the Gas Turbine Research Establishment, DRDO and the Ministry of Defense.

items.statement: Inaugurated 7,600 sqm dedicated facility for Baker Hughes in April 2026; dedicated OEM facilities create operational stickiness and multi-year visibility
items.quote: In April 2026, we officially inaugurated our fourth dedicated lean manufacturing facility, a state -of-the-art 7,600 square meter facility, custom-built for Baker Hughes.

items.statement: Maintained volume growth guidance of north of 20% for FY27
items.quote: we are maintaining that we are growing north of 20% on volume. And we would like to maintain that we are very much confident that we should be growing on a 20% plus volume growth in coming period also

items.statement: Maintenance capex INR20-25 crore, growth capex INR20-30 crore for FY27 and FY28
items.value: INR20-25 crore maintenance, INR20-30 crore growth
items.quote: my general maintenance capex will be in range of INR20 crores to INR25 crores. And growth capex when I say growth capex it would be only for my existing capability augmentation or certain debottleneck it should be in the range of same range around INR20 crores to INR30 crores

items.statement: Gross margin at 35.5% in Q1 FY27, expected to maintain in range of 35.5% +/- 2% for full year
items.quote: as of now, we have posted a gross margin of around 35.5%. So, our overall at a full year level, this should maintain between this range plus minus 2%

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 15-16% +/- 2% blended level
items.quote: on an average level, our margin profile will remain 15% and 16% blended level, which having a contribution all those business areas and manufacturing capabilities, plus minus 2% to factor all those volatilities

items.statement: Jammu plant posted positive EBITDA of INR1-1.5 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: we are pleased to inform that this quarter we have posted a positive EBITDA for Jammu to the tune of INR1 crores to INR1.5 crores

items.statement: Long-term margin expected to improve to 17-18% as Jammu matures
items.quote: I think it 17%, 18% is the fair number

items.statement: Jammu plant revenue INR107 crore in Q1 FY27, up from INR90 crore in Q4 FY26
items.quote: this quarter we have achieved a revenue of around INR107 crores from Jammu

items.statement: Jammu plant capacity utilization at 25-30% annualized in Q1 FY27
items.quote: we are looking at a capacity utilization of around 25% to 30% on an annualized basis, based on the performance of this particular quarter

items.statement: Jammu plant optimum revenue potential INR1,400 crore at 65-70% utilization
items.quote: INR1,400 crores. that is an optimum revenue that we anticipate at a utilization of 65% to 70%

items.statement: Healthy demand across CDMO and branded generic businesses, momentum sustainable
items.quote: With healthy demand across our businesses and continued execution focus, we believe the momentum is sustainable in the future also

items.statement: Pricing trending upward this quarter, pass-through model for API costs
items.quote: this quarter the price is which toward increase side

items.statement: FY27 capex of INR200-225 crores for new facility completion plus maintenance capex
items.quote: So in terms of this year, we are going to do close to INR200 crores to INR225 crores, balance of this INR150 crores plus some maintenance capex and all kind of things.

items.statement: Current order book stands at INR4,848 crores with diversified industry mix
items.quote: As of today, our order book stands at INR4,848 crores, providing a good revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

items.statement: FY27 order inflow guidance of INR2,500-3,000 crores
items.quote: Order book, let's say, we are very much clear that this year, the first quarter, we took almost INR600 crores, and we are expecting to finish this entire year in between INR2,500 crores to INR3,000 crores there.

items.statement: Export license delays from EU defense ministries for China/Turkey customers; applying from day 1 now; no impairment expected
items.quote: Everywhere. See basically, particularly our customers are all into China, Turkey. So these are all our sensitive areas basically today's time line.

items.statement: Operating cash flow expected at ~50% of EBITDA conversion for FY27
items.quote: Basically, this year, we are expecting close to 50% of EBITDA level there.

items.statement: Expect near-term PHS retention drag to fully normalize through FY27
items.quote: And we have demonstrated through multiple disclosures over the last quarters on how the EBITDA margins have improved quarter-on-quarter from our lowest in Q2 FY26. And we expect this near-term PHS retention drag will get fully normalized through FY27.

items.statement: Spent INR24.5 crores over last 6 quarters on Board-approved AI roadmap
items.quote: In fact, we spent about INR24.5 crores over the last 6 quarters in a Board-approved AI road map.

items.statement: 7 insurers contracted across MAven, MAtrix and Magnum stacks including AI components
items.quote: And we have today 7 insurers contracted across combinations of MAven, MAtrix and the Magnum stacks, including all of our AI components.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin at 20.3% in Q1 FY27, up from 17.1% in Q2 FY26

items.statement: MAven Guard fraud savings engine delivered over INR183 crores of fraud savings in Q1
items.quote: And MAven Guard, our fraud, waste and abuse engine continues to improve in its outcomes, delivered over INR183 crores of fraud savings in Q1.

items.statement: Group premiums grew 29.5% YoY with market share at 37.6%
items.quote: Our group revenues grew 25.5% year-on-year with the premiums growing 29.5% year-on-year and the group market share at 37.6%.

items.quote: The 3.3 percentage revenue came from technology SaaS business translating to INR7.8 crores, representing a 55.5 percentage growth year-on-year.

items.quote: The Q1 performance is temporarily impacted due to the ongoing softness or moderation in student, leisure and marine volumes all in the same quarter.

items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR39 crores as against INR32 crores in the last year same quarter, reflecting a growth of 24.6%, which is more than the revenue growth, so the pricing is better.

items.quote: I believe we should be increasing the guidance of Mehru above 15% what we were earlier. I think our revised guidance for Mehru would be around 18%.

items.statement: Endoks EBITDA margin currently ~18% for existing products; BESS margins to be assessed after shipments
items.quote: Endoks you will have to give us some time. The current product lines where they are already present, like STATCOM, SVCs, automations, I think they are normally around 25%. With the BESS coming in, we will have to just have a look at it.

items.statement: Sangli facility trial production targeted this month; commercial revenue expected Q3, meaningful Q4
items.quote: I would say start looking at Q3. Some revenue trickling in, Q4 is when you would see some turnarounds.

items.statement: HVDC CTC Magnet Wire facility at Sangli: machines arriving, full production expected by Q4 FY27 after 3-5 months stabilization
items.quote: We are anticipating by Q4 of this year is when we will be able to take up full production out of the facility.

items.statement: Endoks Power Conversion Systems facility in Turkey: civil complete, operations expected Q3 FY27
items.quote: At Endoks in Turkey, civil construction of the power conversion system facility is complete, with operations expected to begin during Q3 this year.

items.statement: Order book slated for execution over next 15 months; factories sitting on ~2 years order book at current capacities
items.quote: This order book what we have, Rahul, this order book is slated to completion in the next 15 months, give and take. So that gives you an idea how much we can eat.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 47.2% (up from 44.6%); reported EBITDA margin 25.2%; adjusted EBITDA margin 28.3% excluding INR 7.82 cr hyperinflation loss
items.quote: Revenue for the quarter was INR256.4 crores. Gross profit was INR121 crores, with gross margin improving to 47.2% from 44.6%. Reported EBITDA was INR64.7 crores at a margin of 25.2%.

items.statement: Temporary standalone margin moderation expected in Q3 FY27 due to Sangli fixed costs (depreciation, manpower, power, overheads) before full utilization; normalization over 15 months
items.quote: We therefore expect some temporary moderation in standalone margins, particularly in Q3. As utilization increases over the next 15 months, we expect these costs to be progressively absorbed and margins to normalize.

items.statement: Pricing discipline maintained: all executable orders booked above margin guidance; INR 3 cr volume discounts from group procurement in Q1
items.quote: Importantly, every executable order currently in our order book has been booked above the margin guidance communicated to the market. We have not compromised pricing discipline to build volume.

items.statement: Strong demand across portfolio: transmission expansion, renewable integration, HVDC/FACTS, grid modernization, energy storage, data center power; Endoks BESS inquiries ahead of expectations
items.quote: More broadly, the demand environment remains supportive across our portfolio, driven by transmission expansion, renewable integration, HVDC and FACTS deployment, grid modernization, energy storage and data center power infrastructure.

items.statement: Power electronics (BESS) highest growth near-term; high voltage power products second; ancillaries largely internal consumption supporting other segments
items.quote: I think the highest growth will come from power electronics sector because of the BESS coming in. The second growth area would be the high voltage power products, and ancillary is technically an internal consumption.

items.statement: Fund raise < INR 500 cr planned (roadshows from Aug 20) for Winwin acquisition (EV ~INR 315 cr), INR 50 cr capex at Winwin, US sales office/team, next-gen tech
items.quote: We have not put numbers to it, but less than INR500 crores.

items.statement: Winwin acquisition consolidation expected Q4 FY27 due to SEZ bureaucratic approvals; lockbox agreement protects against pre-closing losses
items.quote: I think consolidation will happen out of Q4, not before that, primarily because this being an SEZ property, it will require a lot of secretaries to sign off in Delhi.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 60-70% YoY for FY27 maintained; full-year revenue target ~INR 320-340 crore
items.quote: We gave a guidance of about 60% to 70% growth and that remains unchanged. There is no challenge at all.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of ~30% for FY27 maintained
items.quote: That remains unchanged.

items.statement: Targeting 60-70% CAGR for next 2-3 years; revenue ~INR 850-900 crore by FY29
items.quote: Yes, year-on-year, you can say CAGR, 60%-70% we are targeting for next 2-3 years.

items.statement: International margins 30-40% vs domestic 15-20%; blended EBITDA target 35%+ in 2 years
items.quote: In next 2 years, we should target at least 35% EBITDA margin, or maybe more than that.

items.statement: PPaaS contribution reduced to ~5% projection; RegTech and SaaS subscription models scaling
items.quote: We brought down our projection in the PPaaS segment to just about 5% to reduce the risk associated with that segment.

items.statement: RegTech gaining traction: order from large PSU, SaaS subscription for mid/small banks launching, AI risk intelligence at 98% accuracy
items.quote: In RegTech, we have picked up deals in cooperative segment and now we have an order from large PSU as well.

items.statement: Inorganic acquisitions focused on geographical access, new products, growth trajectory; not expected in Q2
items.quote: I think Q2 is early, I don't think. But we will come back on this one.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of over 25% for FY27, implying ~INR1,600 crores top line
items.quote: From a growth perspective, we remain confident of delivering a revenue growth of over 25% in FY27.

items.statement: Medium-term target of over 20% CAGR over next 3-4 years with progressive profitability improvement
items.quote: Based on our internal medium-term business plan, we are confident of achieving over 20% CAGR over the next three to four years, along with a progressive improvement in profitability.

items.statement: Order book at INR1,053 crores end of Q1 FY27, up 25% YoY; Phenix INR837 crores (79%), Proflex INR216 crores (21%)
items.quote: Order on hand stood at INR1,053 crores at the end of Q1FY27, representing approximately 25% year on year growth.

items.statement: Board approved INR30 crores for automated heavy structural steel line at Sanand adding 10,000 tons (12k to 22k tons), operational by Q1 FY28
items.quote: M&B is investing INR30 crores in a fully automated heavy structural steel processing line at the Sanand facility. The new line will add another 10,000 tons to our existing heavy structural capacity of 12,000 tons. It is expected to become operational by Q1 of FY28.

items.statement: Cheyyar brownfield expansion adding 20,000 tons PEB/structural capacity, completion planned Q3 FY28; total capacity ~154,000 tons by Q3 FY28
items.quote: We will also commence implementation of the brownfield expansion at Cheyyar during the current fiscal year with completion planned for Q3 of FY28. This expansion will add another 20,000 tons per annum of capacity and increase our total PEB and structural steel capacity to approximately 1,54,000 tons per annum effective

items.statement: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 11.4%; management targets improvement in H2 FY27 but defers specific guidance by one quarter due to cost volatility
items.quote: We want to improve it, however given the extremely volatile situation on the cost front, we have not given any specific guidance but we will give a specific guidance in the next quarter, but be clear the target is to improve over what we have achieved today.

items.statement: Export margins at 15% worst-case at current peak freight (USD10-12k/container), normal 16-17%; domestic ~11%; delta ~4-5% vs historical 8-9%
items.quote: At the current freight costs, assuming that nothing goes down, we still calculated that that should still give you around 15% EBITDA margins. Now, in a good situation, it could be 16%- 17%, in the worst situation, it is 15%.

items.statement: IPO proceeds utilization 57% (INR146.69 crores of INR259.32 crores) as of June 30, 2026; INR8.88 crores utilized in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Out of the net IPO proceeds of INR259.32 crores, INR146.69 crores have been utilized so far, that is 57% of the funds have been utilized as on 30th June 2026. During the quarter, INR8.88 crores was utilized out of the IPO proceeds.

items.statement: FY27 operational bed target of 3,000-3,500, up from 2,400 currently
items.quote: In FY27, I had said I will do 3,000 to 3,500 operational beds. I will do 3,000 plus this year.

items.statement: Planning 3-4 ultra-luxury wellness centers (108 rooms + 22 villas each) across India, first in Manali starting Sep-Oct 2026
items.quote: We are planning to launch three to four such luxury premium wellness in four different corners of all over India, which will give us at least around INR3 crores to INR5 crores profit from each center

items.statement: Maintains 40%+ EBITDA margin and 27-30% net profit margin target long-term
items.quote: I would like to remain a company with 27% to 30% net profit and EBITDA of 40% plus in future also.

items.statement: Reduced ticket size for underprivileged patients (INR4,000-6,000) to fill 500 beds in 10 days ahead of Ayushman Bharat empanelment
items.quote: I will start 500 beds in 10 days, in which I will start taking poor patients in INR4,000, INR5,000, INR6,000.

items.statement: Government/credit business deliberately reduced to one-third YoY and QoQ to eliminate receivables risk; private Panchakarma revenue grew ~30% YoY to INR100 crore
items.quote: Government business came down from INR15 crores to INR5 crores in this quarter. So that INR10 crores decline in hospital business is not a drop in operational business; I deliberately shut down credit business.

items.statement: IPD patients up 33% YoY to 11,500; daycare volume up 31% YoY; OPD up 22% YoY; VOPD consultations up 65% YoY
items.quote: Panchakarma revenue growing 13% in Q1 FY27, supported by a 33% YoY increase in IPD patients and a 31% increase in day care volume.

items.statement: Ayurveda product business grew 47% YoY in Q1 FY27 driven by broader portfolio and expanding customer base
items.quote: Our Ayurveda healthcare product business continued to perform strongly, growing 47% YoY during the quarter.

items.statement: ZeroTouch expected to contribute 20-22% of revenue within two years
items.quote: So, we are planning to achieve this target by maximum in two years. So, this year will have a very good potential coming into this financial year and the next financial also will achieve a greater. So, our planning timeline is into the next two years.

items.statement: ZeroTouch pipeline of Rs 5-6 crore expected this year; currently only pilot orders
items.quote: So, as of now, we have a pilot order confirmed. The upcoming, as per your questions, on this year, we are expecting to have a minimum Rs. 5 crores to Rs. 6 crores order on ZeroTouch in this year only.

items.statement: ERP order book of Rs 75 crore for next two years including ARAM contracts
items.quote: So, as I previously answered, I think Kapil has asked the question. So, we have as of now Rs. 75 crore order book for the next two years. That is the new order as well as our ARAM, which is our long-term contract with the government.

items.statement: ZeroTouch EBITDA margin expected at 55-60% vs ERP business
items.quote: So, from ZeroTouch, EBITDA margin is expected to be between 55% to 60% compared to the ERP. Definitely, this is a unique product, patented product and it is as of now it is very needy product.

items.statement: Target consolidated EBITDA margin range of 42-46% over next few years
items.quote: So, our focus has always been to range between 42% to 46%.

items.statement: Revenue split 60% education ERP, 40% manufacturing ERP; online exam part of education
items.quote: So, last, we have a like total revenue is distributed into the, 60% is coming from our education ERP and entire vertical of education and 40% is coming from the manufacturing.

items.statement: ZeroTouch follows DaaS model: revenue per question paper printed and delivered
items.quote: The ZeroTouch machine is completely DaaS model. So, device is a service. So, we are not selling this machine to any of our institutes or any customers. We provide completely end-to-end service. So, our revenue model is based on the number of question paper getting print and delivered at the classroom.

items.statement: Planning strategic acquisitions in technology, education, FinTech, AI, data center; disciplined approach
items.quote: So, we are currently planning to have a strategic acquisition for various focus areas that is technology, education, FinTech, AI and data center. These are the five areas. Also, company is working for a strategic acquisition but we are very sure that our acquisition strategy will remain very disciplined with potential

items.statement: Employee cost increase from sales team expansion across major states will continue; may rise further if more expansion needed
items.quote: As Prashant I had explained that we had expanded our sales and marketing team across the major states of India. Right. So, the proposed net what is increased now will keep continuing. But the same range, maybe if it is required to expand more sales team, that can be increased.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 689 lakh, EBITDA Rs 344 lakh, PAT Rs 201 lakh; 100%+ revenue growth, 115% EBITDA growth, 93% PAT growth YoY
items.quote: So, we have recorded the revenues in Quarter 1 of Rs. 689 lakhs with the EBITDA of Rs. 344 lakhs and PAT margin, sorry PAT after tax, profit after tax is Rs. 201 lakhs. So, compared to the last quarter, sorry 1st Quarter of the last financial year, we have done on an average more than 100% growth on a revenue and almos

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margins to improve to 14-15% in Q2 FY27 and reach 18-20% run rate by Q4 FY27, subject to stable raw material prices
items.quote: Accordingly, we expect EBITDA margins to improve to between 14% to 15% in Q2 FY27 and reach the normal state of 18% to 20% on a run rate basis by Q4 '27, subject to raw material prices remaining broadly stable.

items.statement: Full year FY27 volume growth expected at 8-10%, revenue growth in high teens
items.quote: So, the volume growth estimate for full year would be close to, between 8% and 10%, I think. Minimum. More, actually it is closer to 10%.

items.statement: FY28 standalone revenue growth expected at mid to high teens, with 13-14% volume growth and 3-4% price realization
items.quote: So roughly 13% to 14% should come from volume and 3% to 4% should come from price realization for the next year.

items.statement: Manpower cost up 200 bps due to 35% Haryana minimum wage hike from April; OEMs passing through cost increases except one pending
items.quote: The manpower cost has gone up by 200 bps. And the main reason for that is, that there was a change in the minimum wages in Haryana from 1st of April. There was an increase of 35%.

items.statement: New capacity of 1.5M helmets/year operational from September-October; existing facilities at 81% utilization, highly fungible manufacturing
items.quote: Our first phase of 1.5 million helmets of additional annual capacity is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational beginning October and September.

items.statement: Added 27 new COCO stores in Q1 FY27, total network now 165 stores across 100 cities; on track for 80 COCO store additions in FY27
items.quote: We remain on track to achieve our target of adding about 80 company-owned, company-operated stores during FY27.

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 57.1% in Q1 FY27 from 55.8% YoY; EBITDA margin 13.9%; operating EBITDA margin 9.1%
items.quote: Gross profit for the quarter stood at Rs. 231 crore, up 19.4% YoY, with gross margin improving to 57.1% in Quarter 1 FY27, from 55.8% in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Raw material inflation (polyol, TDI) up 70-160% on spot prices, but net inflation only 30-40% due to supplier relationships; passed on via two ~5% price hikes
items.quote: Although it went up 70%, 80%, 160% we actually saw net inflation only by about 30-40% at various points in time when we acquired it. And that is the reason when we passed on the price to end consumer it was two increases of about 5% each approximately.

items.statement: Mattress revenue grew 27.3% YoY (66% of revenue); two-thirds volume, one-third price; furniture to return to mid-to-late teens growth over next two quarters
items.quote: Mattress contributing 65.9%, about 66% for Q1 FY27 revenue with a healthy 27.3% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Own channels 72.3% of revenue (growing 20.5% YoY); online 52.7%, offline 47.3%; premium mattresses ~15-20% of company sales, ~50% of offline mattress sales
items.quote: Our own channels contributed 72.3% of total revenue, with revenue from these channels growing 20.5% YoY.

items.statement: Full impact of raw material cost increases to flow through H1 FY27; expect ~100 bps gross margin compression in Q2 vs Q1 unless Middle East situation worsens
items.quote: When you look at the overall H1, it might not be more than 100 to 120 basis points unless something else happens in the rest of August and September in terms of driving up the prices.

items.statement: A&P spend to remain 7-8% of revenue for FY27; rental outgo ~Rs. 80-90 crore; ESOP expense Rs. 10-12 crore (lower than earlier Rs. 12 cr guidance)
items.quote: Yes, please because the festive season will also come up now so in that range, it should be this.

items.statement: External marketplace channels grew 7.6% YoY in Q1 after prior declines; benefited from platform growth focus and sale events
items.quote: Our external channels contributed 27.7% of total revenue and delivered 7.6% YoY revenue growth.

items.statement: Jumbo store construction underway: first store targeting June-July 2025, second August-September 2025, both in Bangalore; furniture growth step-jump expected post launch
items.quote: In terms of going live, we target next year June-July for the first store and August-September for the second store, both in Bangalore.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin 9.1% in Q1; steady-state target ~7.5% for FY27 given volatility; 16-17% reported EBITDA margin 2-3 years out
items.quote: We should aspire for the same number this year given the huge volatility in all of the things. Channels, competition, raw material prices.

items.statement: Store catchment areas show 2.7x-3x monthly run-rate growth after offline store opening; 36% revenue from repeat/cross-sell customers
items.quote: That catchment area, which includes online and offline, that growth has remained at about 2.7x-3x. So, if a town was at Rs. 3, it is now at Rs.10 per month.

items.statement: Raw material inventory 3-4 weeks; current inventory cost below spot prices; price hikes paused unless unforeseen increases occur
items.quote: We do have about 3-4 weeks of raw material that is parked with us based on different types of raw materials.

items.statement: Management expects to sustain volume growth of ~26% for full FY27, similar to trailing 12 months.
items.quote: The higher phase one capacity will be available for the full year FY27 as opposed to only for a part of FY26, and therefore, we feel that we should be able to sustain this rate of volume growth for the full year.

items.statement: EBITDA per ton guidance for FY27 is approximately INR 75,000, up from trailing 12-month INR 74,000.
items.quote: We therefore believe that we should be able to sustain approximately INR75,000 per ton for FY27, though the actual performance will depend on the product mix, exports, and currency.

items.statement: Phase 2 expansion at Supa on track for completion by March 2027; next capacity wave expected in Q2 FY27.
items.quote: We are on track to complete the remaining phase two capacity by March 2027 with the next wave of addition expected during Q2.

items.statement: Phase 2 project cost estimated at INR 150-160 crores, largely funded by IPO proceeds; significant spend remaining in FY27.
items.quote: See the overall project cost for phase two like we had mentioned, part funded through the IPO funds, was around INR150 crores to INR160 crores.

items.statement: Board authorized evaluation of acquiring additional 10 acres in Supa MIDC for long-term expansion beyond current 59,000 MT capacity.
items.quote: Our board last night authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for its long-term expansion requirements.

items.statement: Signed 5-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global for winding wires to Indian and global plants; details being finalized.
items.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global to supply winding wires to their Indian plants as well as their some of their global plants.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per ton reached INR 93,000, up from INR 74,000 in Q4 FY26 and INR 66,000 a year ago, driven by record CTC mix, higher exports, better utilization, and weaker rupee.
items.quote: In Q1 of FY27, we reported EBITDA per ton of approximately INR93,000 per metric ton, up from roughly INR74,000 in Q4 and INR66,000 a year ago.

items.statement: Standard wire EBITDA per ton improved marginally as utilization increased; higher kV class (765kV/HVDC) CTC volume trending above 25% of CTC volume.
items.quote: As the round wire or standard winding wire capacity utilization has gone up, the EBITDA per metric ton of standard also has improved marginally from earlier quarters.

items.statement: Copper price and FX are direct pass-throughs via make-to-order model; value addition contracts cover 80-85% of customers with minimal lag (15-20 days manufacturing).
items.quote: We will book the copper once we receive the order, we will book the copper with our supplier, and whatever is the known copper price, that becomes the invoice price for the copper portion for that particular order.

items.statement: Structural T&D demand driven by renewables, grid modernization, urbanization, AI data centers; transformer OEMs expanding capacity with 3-5 year order books.
items.quote: The T&D sector, as you know it, is in a structural long-term cycle driven by renewable energy, grid modernization, urbanization, and growing power demand for AI data centers in India as well as globally.

items.statement: EV motor demand strong for 2W/3W; passenger car/bus volumes expected to become meaningful around FY28-FY29; DG set alternators for data centers growing.
items.quote: Passenger car and bus in terms of volumes, I feel that still, we would say around 2028, you know, FY28, FY29 is where the incremental meaningful volumes would really play.

items.statement: Some transformer OEMs delaying order pickups by weeks due to capacity expansion bottlenecks; expected to normalize as new facilities become operational.
items.quote: We have seen a few of the transformer OEM customers who are in active capacity expansion mode, delay picking up their orders by a few weeks.

items.statement: Working capital days improved to 60 days in Q1 FY27 from 71 days a year ago; target is 30-35 days (industry standard) over multi-quarter process.
items.quote: After showing a five-day average working capital day improvement in Q4, we were able to improve it by another five days in Q1 during Q1, resulting in an average working capital days of 60 days during the quarter compared to 71 days a year ago.

items.statement: Reiterated double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27
items.quote: For FY27, we reiterate our double-digit revenue growth guidance.

items.statement: DG set order book at INR1,700 crores as of July 31, 2026, with INR900 crores data center orders
items.quote: Within our DG set business powered by Cummins, the order book as of 31st July 2026 stood at INR1,700 crores, providing strong visibility for future growth. Out of this, data center -specific orders within this business stood at INR900 crores.

items.statement: Data center order book increased to INR1,100 crores by August 7, 2026
items.quote: as on July 31st, the data center order book stood at INR900, but literally just in the past week, that order book now, like if you would take August 7th as the timestamp, that number would be 1,100.

items.statement: Genset EBITDA margin impacted in Q1 and part of Q2 due to commodity inflation; recovery expected from Q3
items.period: Q1 FY27, Q2 FY27, Q3 FY27
items.quote: due to West Asia crisis, this will be -- the margin will be impacted for Q1 and part of the Q2. So, so this is the period that where the margin will be subdued, but we believe that from Q3 onward, it is going to improve.

items.statement: Two-phase price hike implemented: small increase mid-Q1, balance at start of Q2
items.quote: we took a small price increase in the middle of Q1, and the balance in the start of Q2. So, that's why margins set to be recovering from Q2 and Q3.

items.statement: Data center is fastest-growing segment; manufacturing remains top market; rental is second fastest-growing
items.quote: data center, of course, is our fastest-growing segment, but manufacturing still continues to be our top market segment in terms of percentage, and that's followed by real estate. The second fastest growing is the rental segment.

items.statement: Wind IPP portfolio to grow from 330 MW to 638.35 MW; 50 MW in FY27, 150 MW in FY28, 100 MW in FY29
items.quote: 50 megawatt will be added this current financial year, and next year I think the 150 megawatt will be added, and another 100 megawatt will be added to another financial year.

items.statement: Wind revenue 18.6% of total in Q1 FY27 (IPP 11.5%, EPC/O&M 7.1%); DG sets 81.4%
items.quote: Wind power contributed 18.6% of the total revenue in Q1 FY27, registering a growth of 28.8% Y-o-Y with an EBITDA margin of 48.6%. Within this segment, the IPP business contributed around 11.5% to Q1 FY27 revenues, while the EPC and O&M for BOP contribute approximately 7.1%.

items.statement: Signed PPA for 100 MW GUVNL wind project at INR3.435/kWh for 25 years; LOA received for 100 MW SECI and 50 MW GUVNL projects
items.quote: Last month, we executed a PPA, Power Purchase Agreement, for 100 MW wind project for GUVNL, wind power project it is located in Gujarat at a tariff of 3.435 per kWh for a period of 25 years.

items.statement: EPC wind business executing ~450 MW currently; ~250-300 MW annual execution; ~INR400 crores annual revenue potential
items.quote: you can say approximately the top line would be around INR400 crores of the this EPC business.

items.statement: MSLG order book includes INR41 crore order won recently; international inquiries resuming; PSU second phase in technical discussions
items.quote: recently, we have won one tender of INR41 crores, which is to be executed between 12 months to 15 months. The others are in pipeline.

items.statement: DG set capacity utilization at 75-80% on single shift; sufficient capacity for current demand
items.quote: It's capacity utilization is about between 75% to 80%.

items.statement: RECD business revenue ~INR16-17 crores in Q1 FY27; impacted by crisis and GRAP implementation; expected recovery in coming quarters
items.quote: retrofit emission control devices business, it is strong enough, but this time we have we have about 17 crores, 16 crores of a revenue during the quarter, primarily because of one is the crisis, second is on the GRAP implementation, which was there in the Northern Capital.

items.statement: Management expects numbers to continue going up in FY27 based on strong Q1 and positive response from B2C expansion
items.quote: We will not let the numbers go down anyway. Numbers will be going up as our first quarter you can see.

items.statement: Company-owned boutique stores outside Jaipur estimated at INR5 crores each excluding inventory
items.quote: we are calculating in each store around INR5 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue mix was 78% B2B and 22% B2C, both driven by bridal demand
items.quote: So, we had around 78% of B2B in this Q1 as I have come to know, 22% we have done B2C and both the demands were connected to bridals.

items.statement: Gold price hedged at order booking with customer advance to protect margins from fluctuations
items.quote: Most of the time, it is order booking and when if we get a good advance from the client, we just immediately hedge the gold so that we don't get any kind of fluctuation in our margins and prices.

items.statement: Bridal season demand growing strongly; customers have fixed budgets but want grander designs with lighter gold weight due to high gold prices
items.quote: People have budget and they want to work into that. It's our duty to give them the best of that those budgets. Maybe they get lesser gold, but they will be getting a better design for sure.

items.statement: Expanding into contemporary men's jewellery and lightweight pret jewellery for Gen Z/millennials alongside core bridal
items.quote: We are introducing new collections across emerging categories, including contemporary men's jewellery and lightweight pret jewellery.

items.statement: IPO proceeds used to become debt-free; balance funds (approx INR52-57 crores) held for working capital and future expansion
items.quote: the first thing which was there was getting debt-free, that we are already done. And the balance fund, I think we have around -- I think around we have still -- we have around 52 and the 7, I think it is.

items.statement: Order book at INR27,884 million as of June 2026, split between manufacturing and EPC
items.quote: Our order book stood at approximately INR27,884 million as of June '26. This comprises of INR14,327 million of manufacturing order and INR13,557 million of EPC order.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 12.6% in Q1 FY27 from 11.5% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA grew by approximately 26% to INR659 million, and EBITDA margins improved to 12.6% from 11.5% in Quarter 1 of FY26.

items.statement: India conductor market expected to reach INR230-250 billion by FY30; HTLS tenders worth INR3,500 crores floated in last year
items.quote: According to CRISIL's Intelligence, India's conductor market increased from approximately 102 billion in FY20 to approximately 185 billion in FY25, and this is expected to reach 230 to 250 billion by FY30.

items.statement: High-voltage cable share grew from 9% to 29% of revenue in last 9 quarters; manufacturing split 90% cables, 10% conductors
items.quote: In last nine quarters, we have increased our high-voltage cable sales from 9% of our total revenue to almost 29% of our total revenue in last nine quarters.

items.statement: Finance cost absorbed 55% of Q1 EBITDA; IPO proceeds used to repay INR4,900 million debt, expected to save INR40 crores annual interest
items.quote: Finance cost absorbed approximately 55% of quarterly EBITDA and remained a principal factor moderating the conversion of operating profitability into PAT.

items.statement: IPO completed July 2026; INR4,900 million proceeds used for debt repayment; gross debt now INR3,600 million
items.quote: Approximately INR4,900 million of IPO proceed was utilized towards the repayment of loan outstanding. Gross debt currently stand at approximately INR3,600 million.

items.statement: Working capital typically 100-120 days; Q1 spike due to EPC project mobilization, expected to normalize
items.quote: Our working capital typically range between 110 to 120 days, 100 to 120 days, actually. And there could be some spike in a particular reporting date because of various reason.

items.statement: EPC margins typically 15-20% EBITDA but vary by project milestone timing
items.quote: EPC margin roughly stands between somewhere 15% to 20%, but EPC margin can't be look at a particular quarter or at a particular moment, because that will depend on a single project milestone.

items.statement: Manufacturing capacity 85,000 metric tons; utilization ~62% overall, cables ~80%; capacity expanded ahead of demand
items.quote: Our manufacturing operations are supported by three manufacturing units, with an aggregate installed capacity of around 85,000 metric tons.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 45-50% YoY driven by full-year execution of recent orders
items.quote: And we will be doing a revenue growth of about 45% to 50% Y -o-Y. This is driven by full -year execution of orders which we have won recently.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA growth targeted at 35%+ YoY subject to fuel cost normalization
items.quote: Apart from that, we are targeting to have an EBITDA growth of 35% plus year -on-year subject to fuel cost spikes which we are expecting to normalize.

items.statement: FY27 PAT growth expected at 35%+ YoY reflecting interest cost savings
items.quote: PAT growth we are again expecting to be in the range of 35% plus year-on-year reflecting a margin which will be having because of savings in interest cost as well.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 9,124 crores including GST as of June 30, 2026 with 46-month average duration
items.quote: Our order book stood robust at INR9,124 crores including GST as of June 30, 2026. Out of the revenue of INR657 crores, INR597 crores, that is approximately 91%, came from coal mining services.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 is 20.02% after excluding INR 10.57 cr diesel escalation revenue; steady-state margin guided at 23%+
items.quote: However, our revenue for the quarter includes a revenue of INR10.57 crores related to diesel escalation which has been given to us by Coal India. So if we report that, our EBITDA margin stands at 20.02% for this quarter.

items.statement: Diesel prices spiked from INR 90 to INR 154 during Iran war; currently at INR 110-120 range and expected to normalize
items.quote: See, initially the diesel which was at INR90 scaled up to INR112, then in the range of INR130 to INR140, and then it also picked up to INR154 rupees, sir. Now, that same diesel also touched a low of INR98, and then today it is standing at INR110 to INR120 range, sir.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at INR 450 crores (INR 167 cr cash, INR 283 cr debt) for current orders; no new tenders assumed
items.quote: Sir, if we are talking about the current orders which we have secured, we in the complete year we will be adding up INR450 crores sir. Out of that INR450, INR167 will be in the cash part, sir. So on the loan part if we don't add up any further tender from here on, sir, INR283 will be in the form of loan.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of INR 208 crores used for debt repayment; year-end debt expected at INR 750 crores
items.quote: We started off the year with INR1,024 crores of debt, and we will do some run -down as well in the current year by paying EMIs. And we are ad hoc payment of INR208 crores. So we expect that by year -end we should close at roughly around INR750 crores worth of debt.

items.statement: No slowdown in coal demand; power sector growing daily; contracts not dependent on coal volume but on overburden removal
items.quote: No. We are -- one thing is very clear that there is no weakening demand for coal, because you see the power sector, and power sector is growing every day and demand is growing every day.

items.statement: Actively bidding for 8-10 coal/OB tenders; evaluating iron ore, MDO and critical mineral opportunities
items.quote: We do started bidding for other coal contracts already from last month itself. And there are a couple of contracts -- couple of tenders which are in pipeline right now. We have participated in more than 8 to 10 tenders right now and we are awaiting results. Apart from that, we are actively looking for opportunities in

items.statement: Key scaling risk is maintaining execution discipline and building senior professional team as sites grow from 10 to 15-20
items.quote: Apart from this sir, we will have to keep building up a good, sound, senior professional team which will keep the work at the site happening at the momentum and at the discipline we need sir.

items.statement: Fuel escalation clauses cover 86% of revenue (coal mining); timing mismatch causes partial pass-through; logistics also affected by diesel spikes
items.quote: Sir, a major, if you see 86% of our revenue comes from coal mining. So all our coal mining projects are covered with fuel escalation costs.

items.statement: Credit rating upgraded from BBB+ to A- with positive outlook post-IPO; cost of debt 8.5-9% expected to decline
items.quote: I'm happy to share that we have got one notch improvement from BBB positive to A minus with a positive outlook. The outlook has also been upgraded.

items.statement: Q2 overburden removal target ~34 million cubic meters vs 43.37 in Q1; Q3-Q4 expected to be strongest quarters post-monsoon
items.quote: Sir, the monsoon is a weak quarter for our sector sir. And number 2 sir, as we have done 43 million cubic meter in quarter 1, we wish to do approximately 34 million cubic meter in quarter 2 sir.

items.statement: Cost push of 5-6% from synthetic raw materials; commensurate price increases taken to protect margins
items.quote: So broadly, the cost push what we have witnessed is in the range of about 5% to 6%. And as Gunjan mentioned that we have taken a similar price increase to ensure our margins are protected.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 130 bps YoY; would have been 230-240 bps without channel mix dilution of ~100 bps
items.quote: Although gross margin got diluted because of the channel mix, otherwise, we should have seen an uplift of about 230 bps, 240 bps versus the 130 bps what you see right now.

items.statement: Vendor consolidation from ~120 to ~60 partners; targeting 15 core + 15 satellite over 3-5 years for ~200 bps margin improvement
items.quote: So all this clocked together over this journey period, right, which is spanning across multiple years, should give us about 200 basis points thereabouts.

items.statement: Premiumization driving ASP growth; Hush Puppies and Floatz leading; ladies category strong; NorthStar rationalized for relaunch
items.quote: By March '27, you should see a significant change in the portfolio of products we are offering to consumers, right, with, as I mentioned, a significant amount of authority from Bata on design and comfort, backed by technology.

items.statement: Broad-based growth across channels; ZBM at 80% of COCO revenue (775 stores); franchise at 750 stores; e-commerce and MBO healthy
items.quote: We did see broad-based growth across channels. ZBM expanded to almost now 80% business contributing stores, close to 800. Franchise expanded to 750.

items.statement: Elevated marketing spend to continue (25% YoY in Q1); A&P at 3-3.5% of sales vs 2.5% year ago; will support premium product launches
items.quote: Right now, you can look at whatever is the current trend line, which would be about between 3%, 3.5% versus about 2.5% a year back.

items.statement: Crossed 2,000 EBO stores (1,250 COCO + 750 franchise); targeting 3,000 stores; franchise potential trade areas >600
items.quote: We also crossed the landmark of 2,000 EBO stores, the first obviously, brand or a banner in the country to cross 2,000. And we now obviously have desire to move towards 3,000 in the coming future.

items.statement: Cost inflation impact delayed by 140-150 days inventory; full price hike impact visible from September; competitive intensity at lower price points uncertain
items.quote: As I mentioned, we hold between 140 and 150 days of inventory anyway. So by that time, the new price stock will start hitting the market at a large scale, that would be sometime towards, let's say, September.

items.statement: Inventory turns at industry-best 2.5-2.7x; full-price sales near 90%; employee costs flat due to VRS and organizational restructuring
items.quote: Inventory progress continued year-on-year now for 2 years running. Stock turns are at industry best at about 2.5 plus. In fact, now edging towards 2.7.

items.statement: Membrane manufacturing in Goa targeting 3x business growth; second plant coming up for UF/MBR with full integrated range.
items.quote: Overall, the plan is to have a 3x business growth over the years. And with this kind of a range that we are building in membranes in our Goa facility, the second plant is coming up, we will be the only manufacturer in India to have the full range of integrated membrane facilities.

items.statement: Specialty Chemicals recorded double-digit growth in both revenue and EBIT.
items.quote: Specialty chemicals has recorded double-digit growth in both of their top-line revenue as well as on the profitability EBIT.

items.statement: Portugal (MAPRIL) acquisition integrated; sees significant upside in Iberia & North Africa across resins, chemicals, membranes, solutions over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: We believe that the success from those countries, those geographies in the next two to three years will be significantly more.

items.statement: WQA certification obtained for US market access; combined with Roha commissioning and new Americas leadership, expects progressive revenue uptick per past plan.
items.quote: So, yes, with the WQA certification, with our Roha plant commission, with our leadership team in place in some of these global markets, we will see an uptick on the businesses, based on which premise the investment was approved.

items.statement: Expect at least 50% revenue increase in specialty chemicals over next couple of years as Roha plant reaches full capacity
items.quote: So, currently, our specialty chemical, as you just mentioned, is just under INR 900 crore for the year for '25-'26. So, we expect a substantial increase of at least 50% in this capacity over the next couple of years.

items.statement: Pharma resin capacity expansion 6x underway at Ankleshwar, completion expected in next 12 months with manageable capex
items.quote: It is in the process. The pharma resins are not measured by volume, but value. And we believe that we have the necessary actions being put in place to get this up and done in the next 12 months.

items.statement: Significant part of Roha plant capacity utilization expected from overseas markets, especially North America
items.quote: We expect a significant part of our Roha plant capacity utilization to come from overseas markets and specifically the North American market.

items.statement: Focus shifting to high-tech solutions: resource recovery, brine valorization, water electrolysis, lithium extraction, ultra-pure water for semiconductors
items.quote: We will be one of the very few companies in the world who can offer resource recovery, brine valorization, water electrolysis, lithium extraction. These are high-tech spaces, and that is where we believe if we move towards that, fully changes the profile mix.

items.statement: Birla Opus paints FY27 revenue growth guided over 50% year-on-year
items.quote: Yes, on a Y-on-Y basis we are guiding over 50% revenue, which is the second part of your question.

items.statement: Birla Pivot B2B e-commerce on track for EBITDA break-even by exit of FY27
items.quote: Birla Pivot remains on track to achieve EBITDA break-even by exit of FY27.

items.statement: Standalone capex for FY27 expected at INR3,157 crores with 45% growth capex; Q1 spend INR375 crores (12% of budget)
items.quote: Coming to capital expenditure, the standalone plan for FY27 is expected at INR3,157 crores. Nearly 45% of this capex is dedicated to growth capex. The total spent in quarter one stood at INR375 crores which is nearly 12% of the budget.

items.statement: Birla Opus paints took cumulative 8.8% price increase in Q1 FY27 to absorb 20-25% raw material cost shock; some impact flowing to Q2
items.quote: We absorbed a genuine and an unprecedented raw material cost shock. We chose to manage it through phased price increases rather than one blunt correction, and the cumulative impact in quarter one FY27 was 8.8% and some of the price increase impact has flown to quarter two of FY27.

items.statement: Birla Opus institutional channel has robust pipeline of 47,000 project sites at various stages; 83+ specification approvals secured
items.quote: With a robust pipeline of 47,000 sites at various stages of work, the institutional business is becoming a meaningful long-term growth vector.

items.statement: Consolidated net debt/EBITDA improved to 1.45x (June 2026) from 1.62x year ago; standalone net debt INR9,899 crores due to timing of ABC investment and UltraTech dividend
items.quote: On balance sheet, as profitability improved, consolidated net debt to TTM EBITDA declined to 1.45 times as on 30th June 2026 compared to 1.62 times in the same period last year.

items.statement: Net debt/EBITDA to be maintained below 2.0x for full year FY27
items.quote: We will be maintaining our net debt below two.

items.statement: Cellulosic fibers: China supply discipline constructive; CSF volumes down 4% YoY due to maintenance and subdued downstream demand; specialty mix up to 27%
items.quote: CSF sales volumes were down 4% year-on-year. Two reasons for volume degrowth: planned maintenance that reduced production, and subdued downstream demand. Specialty fiber moved from 21% of the sales mix to 27%, led by exports.

items.statement: FY27 is a quiet year for lease expiries; no significant renewals or expiries expected
items.quote: 26-27 is a fairly quiet year in terms of any significant leave and license agreements expiring or getting off in terms of any of the existing leave and license agreements expiring.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain steady around current levels based on existing contracts
items.quote: We feel that based on the contracts we have in place, they should not be very, they should not fluctuate greatly. Yes, very steady.

items.statement: Only routine maintenance capex planned for NKP; no significant redevelopment or expansion investments
items.quote: Nothing significant in NKP apart from the routine CAPEX that we have for upgradations and to ensure that licensed premises and the Park in general is of an international quality.

items.statement: FY26 dividend increased to Rs 30/share from Rs 26; FY27 dividend not yet discussed internally
items.quote: Over the past few years, it was Rs. 26 a share. This year, for the Financial Year 25-26, we have increased it to Rs. 30 a share. And going ahead, 26-27, Mr. Khan, it is a little bit, we just do not want to specifically say what the dividend will be.

items.statement: Q2 business on books vs same time last year is very positive; foreign tourist arrivals expected to normalize in Q3 and Q4
items.quote: What I can say is for the next quarter, which is Q2, business on books vis-a-vis the same time last year is very positive.

items.statement: Industry ARR expected to increase for current year due to limited supply and MICE events like BRICS and Aviation show
items.quote: For the current year, we continue to see increase in ARR due to limited supply, and MICE events like BRICS as well as Aviation show, which will happen in the later part of the year.

items.statement: Q1 capex spend of Rs 148 crores on planned projects; healthy cash balance supports long-term growth plans for next 3-4 years
items.quote: We spent, out of that, Rs 148 crores on CAPEX and the projects which were already planned.

items.statement: Robust expansion plan of almost 30 new properties to be operational by 2031, including managed and owned hotels
items.quote: We are working on a robust expansion plan of almost 30 new properties, which will be in operation by 2031, which includes managed as well as our owned hotels.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin impacted by Rajgarh ramp-up, higher marketing spend, IT expenditure, and renovation write-offs; like-to-like EBITDA margin ~30.6% excluding Rajgarh
items.quote: On a like-to-like basis without Rajgarh itself, as against our 29% EBITDA for the current quarter, if I look at like-to-like basis and take out the Rajgarh, that brings our EBITDA to almost 30.6 %.

items.statement: Power and fuel costs increased due to Hormuz crisis/Iran-US war; extra marketing spend of Rs 4 crores to drive domestic bookings
items.quote: We had done almost ₹4 crores of extra marketing expenditure to make sure that we get extra domestic bookings to offset the international tourist arrivals, which was actually below by 10% in Q1.

items.statement: Strong domestic demand offset West Asia crisis impact on foreign arrivals; international guest arrivals down 10% in Q1, expected to continue in Q2, recovery hoped for Q3-Q4
items.period: Q1 FY27, Q2 FY27, Q3-Q4 FY27
items.quote: In Q1, there was a fall in international guests coming to our hotels and we saw that in any hotel that has a dependency on foreign visitors staying at the hotel. In Q2, that we would expect that trend to continue just given what's happening in West Asia.

items.statement: Kolkata Oberoi opening delayed to 2029 due to structural safety compliance work on heritage building and 2-month construction halt after Kolkata incident; Grand Hotel opening targeted September 2028 with 197 keys
items.quote: So Kolkata is an unusual hotel because it's a very old historic building. And anytime you're doing a restoration of an old building, there are unknown factors.

items.statement: Renovations at Mumbai hotels (120 keys at Trident Nariman Point, Oberoi Mumbai) to complete by September, ahead of schedule; Q2 renovations at Oberoi Bangalore (18 rooms) and Trident BKC (57 rooms) also to finish before October
items.quote: So, in fact, in South Bombay, we'll finish the 4 -floors, 120 keys, one month ahead of schedule. So, instead of finishing in October, we'll finish in September.

items.statement: Oberoi Rajgarh Palace (opened Nov 2024) will take ~3 years to stabilize; leisure hotels have longer ramp-up due to travel partner lead times
items.quote: It typically takes hotels 3 years to stabilize and leisure hotels typically take a longer time.

items.statement: F&B revenue grew 6-7% in Q1 excluding Rajgarh impact; no degrowth in F&B as previously presumed
items.quote: We almost recorded 6%-7% growth on F&B.

items.statement: RevPAR grew from Rs 11,352 to Rs 12,801 for all hotels (incl. managed); owned hotels RevPAR increased from Rs 13,000 to almost Rs 15,000
items.quote: In overall, in net, our RevPAR grew from 11,352 to 12,801. This is for all hotels, including managed.

items.statement: Consumer Electronics plant in South India planned with INR 80-100 crore investment
items.quote: On Consumer Electronics, again, we have said that once we set up a plant down south, we would be looking at an investment of somewhere between INR80 crores to INR100 crores in that facility.

items.statement: Semiconductor Trays initial investment of INR 5 crores in existing facility
items.quote: Semiconductor Trays, I think we have mentioned that we are looking at investing about INR5 crores in our existing facility, which would meet initial requirements.

items.statement: Gross margin decline in Q1 due to commodity and freight costs; expected to normalize by Q3
items.quote: We expect that the gross margin would come back to normalized level by quarter 3.

items.statement: Healthcare segment revenue grew 85% YoY to INR 142 crores, now 51% of consolidated revenue
items.quote: Healthcare continued to deliver robust performance during Q1 F Y27. Segment revenue grew 85% year-on-year to INR142 crores, contributing approximately 51% of consolidated revenue and becoming our largest business segment for the quarter.

items.statement: Consumer Electronics revenue target of $10 million within 24-30 months; 5 new components won from new customer
items.quote: I think 24 to 30 months is the short answer. Again, this is not a guidance. So this is what our projections look like. We think we can get to that number within 30 months.

items.statement: Additional 25 million pen capacity operational by end of September, total installed capacity ~75 million pens per annum
items.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

items.statement: Dr. Reddy's supply issues in Canada/Brazil but management confident of filling gap with other partners
items.quote: Whatever is happening on a particular partner, the fact is that we actually need to supply more because there's a gap and the gap needs to be filled. And right now, we still have most of the approvals in various markets across the world.

items.statement: Consumer segment expected to maintain FY26 level in FY27, no growth projected
items.quote: this business would probably not grow in the current year. So we will maintain, at a level which we did in FY26.

items.statement: Semiconductor Trays revenue expected to start from Q4 FY27
items.quote: Yes. That's the current Q4 Semicon revenue, yes.

items.statement: Appointed dedicated heads of business development for Europe and North America to secure innovator partnerships
items.quote: I'm pleased to announce that we have appointed dedicated heads of business development for both Europe as well as North America, our 2 priority growth markets. Both are senior industry leaders and with them in place, we are in discussions and confident of securing a partnership with a major global pharmaceutical over t

items.statement: Plan to deliver 2,500 units by end of FY27
items.quote: We plan to deliver 2,500 units by the end of financial year 2027.

items.statement: Expect to achieve slightly higher than past year numbers in next four quarters
items.quote: As this is the phase where the internally the projects are shaping up at the initial spaces and hence in spite of mixed views and reviews of the real estate sector across the industry, we feel that the, at our level, we will be able to achieve a little higher than the past year numbers

items.statement: No new capital investments for business development this financial year
items.quote: Going forward for this financial year, we don't have any program for new capital investments for the business development

items.statement: Will deploy INR 500 crores over three years for hospitality and club projects
