items.quote: We have now expanded our Qwik from a, pilot to a solidifying sort of a growth strategy. And now we have taken in a full-fledged strategy to now 12 cities and delivered 1,25,000 shipments, almost a growth of 100% - more than 100% from March to June, just in three months alone.

items.statement: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin at 4.24% in Q1 FY27 vs 4.98% YoY; India multi-channel EBITDA margin down 290 bps YoY due to gross margin pressure
items.quote: Overall revenue from operations grew by 13% to 2,106 crores. And consolidated EBITDA- adjusted EBITDA grew to 4.24% versus 4.98%. At 289.3 crores, consolidated gross margin likewise to 36.5 from 38.5.

items.statement: International business gross margin expanded 280 bps YoY, adjusted EBITDA loss reduced from 10% to 7% of revenue in Q1 FY27
items.quote: As you can see, we grew 12%, which came with also a gross margin expansion in the comparative quarters by about 280 bps, which then resulted also in the adjusted EBITDA losses by 22% in absolute terms. And in loss terms, as compared to revenue, we had an improvement by 320 bps from 10% to 7%.

items.statement: Passing on crude-linked raw material cost increases and rupee depreciation impact to customers in manufacturing business, expected full pass-through by end of Q2 FY27
items.quote: On the loss of margins in manufacturing business, we have started passing the increase in crude linked raw material prices in manufacturing business to our customers and expect to fully recover it by the end of this quarter.

items.statement: Offline business shifted from width to depth product assortment strategy, driving 15% GMV growth in Q1 FY27 with improved footfalls and conversions
items.quote: Third initiative that we have been speaking about, it's in full flow now. We had talked about that we will realign our product portfolio from a width to a depth strategy has really fully scaled out. The impact of this was visible, even in last quarter, and it continues in this quarter. It has held us to drive footfalls

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions in Middle East pose risk to international business, though market sustained healthy growth in Q1 FY27
items.quote: As we all know, there are some geopolitical disruptions ongoing in the Middle East. However, in our Middle East business both the market sustained a healthy growth and has a higher potential.

items.statement: Management confident of achieving revenue of around INR500+ crores in FY27 and believes current growth pace can be sustained through the year.
items.quote: Based on the momentum we are seeing across our businesses and the pipeline currently in place, we are confident of achieving revenue of around INR500 plus crores in FY27.

items.statement: Management expects quarter-on-quarter revenue to remain relatively flat due to seasonality, with Q2 heavier but corporate travel dipping in festival months.
items.quote: On and all we feel that quarter-on-quarter in our line of business, there will not going to be a substantial growth.

items.statement: Punjab Yatra program valued at INR92 crores covering 1.85 lakh yatris, with daily travel of ~1,100 people and payment cycle of 15 days.
items.quote: Another is the Punjab Yatra program, valued at around INR92 crores and covering approximately 1.85 lakh yatris.

items.statement: Corporate travel vertical launched in April, onboarded 100+ corporate clients, contributing 10-15% of revenue; recurring annual/multi-year relationships.
items.quote: We launched this vertical in April and have already onboarded more than 100 corporate clients.

items.statement: MICE contributed ~INR100 crores (majority) in Q1; corporate travel 10-15%, Punjab Yatra ~15%, rest from leisure/B2B/government.
items.quote: About INR100 crores came from the MICE business and about 10%, 15% came from the corporate business and similarly, about 15% came from the Punjab Yatra.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 6.09% in Q1 (down from 7.17% YoY due to investments in new verticals), but improved sequentially from 4.54%; PAT margin 4.22% (up from 2.15% QoQ).
items.quote: EBITDA margin was 6.09% compared with 7.17% last year. The year-on-year margin movement reflects the investments we are making in building the new verticals.

items.statement: Company aims to migrate to main board within next 12 months; plans to open more offices in South India.
items.quote: One of the biggest milestones is that we would be eligible to come onto main board in next 12 months.

items.statement: MICE business performed well in Q1 with programs across Oceania worth INR32 crores covering 950-1,000 delegates; momentum expected to continue.
items.quote: During the quarter, we completed MICE programs across Oceania region worth around INR32 crores, covering approximately 950 to 1,000 delegates.

items.statement: Corporate travel billing cycles: 1st-15th payable by 20th, 16th-30th payable by 6th-7th of following month; Punjab Yatra priced at INR4,950 per person (govt-paid).
items.quote: Punjab Yatra is about INR4,950 per person. This is for a two night, three days yatra.

items.statement: GMV disclosed for first time at ~INR252 crores in Q1 FY27, providing broader view of transaction scale across businesses.
items.quote: We have also started disclosing GMV, which stood at approximately INR252 crores for the quarter.

items.statement: Jaipur facility capex of INR47 crores, expected operational by mid-November to December 2026
items.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December.

items.statement: Strong demand visibility post IIJS exhibition; Q2 expected to be good with orders in hand for domestic and export
items.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow due to business model of holding ready stock for immediate customer delivery; not order-to-order
items.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis.

items.statement: FY27 is a ramp-up year with no revenue or margin guidance; meaningful revenue from new verticals expected from FY28
items.quote: FY '27 we don't want to guide, it's purely a ramp-up year where we are completely focused on commercializing each of the verticals and we'll give a better guidance, we want to be more accurate with our guidance, so as the year passes, we'll give a more stronger guidance towards the end of the calendar year for the next

items.statement: Krystal products expected to exceed 50% of overall revenue by FY28
items.quote: of course through 28, Krystal products will be more than 50% of the overall revenue.

items.statement: Safranal commercial production started; revenue contribution expected end of Q2 FY27, meaningful from Q3 FY27
items.quote: A revenue contribution through this vertical is expected towards the end of Q2 FY '27 with a more meaningful contribution from Q3 FY '27 as the commercial supplies scale up.

items.statement: Cooling agents (Gemcool 3, 5, 23) production commenced; customer audits completed, initial orders secured; meaningful contribution from Q3 FY27
items.quote: The company expects the business to make a meaningful contribution from Q3 FY '27 as customer qualifications and recurring commercial supply scales up.

items.statement: Phenol derivatives trial production targeted end of Q2 FY27; commercial production Q3 FY27; meaningful revenue from Q4 FY27
items.quote: Commercial production is targeted during Q3 FY '27 subject to completion of the required approvals and quality processes with meaningful revenue contribution expected from Q4 FY '27.

items.statement: Dahej facility capex ~INR270 crores, ~INR265 crores incurred and substantially capitalized
items.quote: Of the total plant capex of approximately INR270 crores, nearly INR265 crores have already been incurred and substantially capitalized.

items.statement: Consolidated gross margin 16.7%, EBITDA margin 3.3% in Q1 FY27; pressured by product mix, higher clove raw material cost, new plant operating costs
items.quote: On consolidated basis, gross profit stood at INR16.5 crores with a gross margin of 16.7%, while EBITDA stood at INR3.3 crores with an EBITDA margin of 3.3%.

items.statement: New products are margin-accretive vs existing portfolio; operating leverage to support margins as utilization improves
items.quote: as we develop new products, so how we're looking at it is, each new product that's coming in, we want it to be like more margin accretive than our existing products.

items.statement: Demand back to normal levels; Western Hemisphere (US, LatAm) ramping up; export order flow strong for mint and new products
items.quote: We effectively are seeing a situation where the demand from the Western Hemisphere, which is largely U.S. and Latin America, is ramping up.

items.statement: Clove supply disrupted by Madagascar floods and port closure (~30 days); shipping challenges persist but material flowing from May
items.quote: there was a major cyclone resulting into flood-like situation in the cultivation areas in Madagascar. As a result of which, the incoming raw material shipments were significantly delayed because even their port in Toamasina was shut down, I believe for a period of close to 30 days.

items.statement: Brazil subsidiary approved to expand distribution reach in Latin America for essential oils, aromatic and specialty chemicals
items.quote: The company has approved the incorporation of a Brazil subsidiary, representing another step towards expanding our distribution reach in Latin America and creating a dedicated platform for our essential oils, aromatic chemicals, and specialty chemicals.

items.statement: Currency depreciation not a tactical advantage due to import-processing-export model and hedging of foreign contracts
items.quote: it is not really a tactical advantage nor is it a disadvantage for us because we import, we hedge our foreign contracts in terms of what the export realization is and then we subsequently export it out.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex INR7.36bn, of which INR5.88bn deployed at Sri City plant; capitalization expected from H2 FY27
items.quote: On the capital expenditure, for the quarter, we land up at INR7.36 billion of out of which INR5.88 billion was deployed at Sri City. We expect capitalization to begin from the second half of this fiscal year as the aircon compressor and room air conditioner lines come on stream.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 12.5% in Q1 FY27, up 110bps YoY and 80bps QoQ; driven by premium mix, calibrated price hikes, operating leverage
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR9.04 billion as compared to INR7.16 billion, a growth of 26.2% with an EBITDA margin of 12.5% as compared to 11.4% in Q1 FY26, an improvement of 110 bps points year-on-year.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases taken across selected categories absorbed input cost inflation without impacting demand; further hikes only if input costs require
items.quote: On the price side, we have already taken a calibrated increase, and which has absorbed well in the market, and further action would only follow if input costs require, but however the cost and the sourcing efficiency will always be the first preference.

items.statement: Broad-based double-digit growth across all categories in Q1; TV and washing machines expected to drive H2 growth; ACs and refrigerators to benefit from premiumization and replacement demand
items.quote: We see demand remaining very healthy across both Home Appliances and Home Entertainment in this financial year. What gives us the confidence that Q1 has already demonstrated that we can deliver a very strong growth even challenging external environment.

items.statement: Premium and Essential series both growing strongly; 55-inch+ TVs grew ~53% YoY and now ~50% of TV revenue; Essential series sold >500k units in Jan-Jun 2026
items.quote: In our product portfolio, 55-inch and above segment has grown roughly around 53% in quarter one. And now our 55-inch plus segment is contributing around 50% of our overall business.

items.statement: B2B segment delivered strong Q1 growth; Information Display LED signages hit highest ever quarterly sales; 36% market share; confident of 20% CAGR trajectory
items.quote: In information display panels, our LED signages recorded its highest ever quarterly sale in the Q1. And with continuous inflow of government and corporate orders, we have also achieved 36% market share in this business.

items.statement: Government imposed quantitative restrictions on compressor imports (60% reciprocating, 70% rotary); LG benefits from local compressor capacity (1mn at Greater Noida, +2mn at Sri City)
items.quote: In this year, 8th of May, the Government of India, they introduced quantitative restriction on the import of compressors. So import of compressors are restricted against the financial year 2024-2025 up to 60% for the reciprocating compressors which we use for refrigerators and around 70% for the rotary compressor which

items.statement: No external borrowing needed; Sri City INR5,000cr investment funded from internal accruals; cash balance INR57.07bn as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Preserving our internal accruals to fund this investment entirely without any external debt is a conscious and deliberate decision that we believe is in the best long-term interest of our shareholders.

items.statement: Localization rate 55.2% in FY26; targeting 65% over next 3-4 years; Sri City plant to accelerate localization and act as export hub
items.quote: Our localization rates for the last full year was at 55.2%. And we are continuing focus on further improving this in current year as well. Over the past years, we have consistently improved our localization rate by 2% to 3% every year and we expect this to maintain trajectory going forward. Our target to reach the loca

items.statement: Data center cooling seen as long-term B2B opportunity; mid-scale segment already revenue-generating; hyper-scale at preliminary evaluation stage; not a key FY27 driver
items.quote: From a materiality standpoint, this is not a key driver for us in FY27 outlook, but yes, it aligns well with our long-term B2B growth strategy.

items.statement: Dividend payout deferred to fund Sri City capex; management commits to review dividend plans as investment progresses and cash generation strengthens
items.quote: We would like to assure our shareholders that this is not a permanent position. As our Sri City investment progresses in a phased manner and our cash generation strengthens further through revenue growth and margin improvement, we definitely plan to review our dividend plans.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guided at INR840 crore (granite INR720 crore, quartz INR100-120 crore) vs FY26 INR645 crore
items.quote: FY27 we will be close to -- we are estimating around INR840 crores against past year's number of INR645 crores.

items.statement: Granite EBITDA margin expected in same range as prior years (50-100 bps variance) unless diesel price impact
items.quote: Granite-wise, we will be achieving whatever we have recorded in the last few years. It will be more or less in the same lines. Except unless we have diesel price impact. We will be we will be like maybe a 50 bps to 100 bps kind of a range, we will be in the same lines as last years.

items.statement: Quartz Phase 2 capex ~INR125 crore split over FY27 and FY28; INR60-70 crore outflow in Q2-Q3 FY27
items.quote: Capex on quartz would be approximately INR125 crores.

items.statement: Sri Lanka project plant build capex ~INR120 crore
items.quote: Sri Lankan project for plant building it's around INR120 crores.

items.statement: Granite demand strong with 35% YoY revenue growth; pricing improved; diesel cost volatility main concern
items.quote: Demand is good, you can see from the numbers we have 35% topline growth. I think if you remove the quartz part, we are still above 30. So I think the demand-wise is good, the pricing-wise we have had a better realization.

items.statement: Quartz sales mix: 65% engineered stone, 35% solar
items.quote: Around 60% to 65% engineered stone, balance solar. I think 65-35 is a reasonable assumption.

items.statement: Quartz production ramp: Q2 FY27 ~20,000 tons/month, Q3 FY27 10,000-12,000 tons/month, Q4 FY27 >15,000 tons/month; FY27 quartz revenue INR100-120 crore
items.quote: This quarter we are looking at around 20,000 and the next quarter by the end of this quarter, we will be able to touch a run rate of 10,000. So next quarter, you can do 10,000 to 12,000. I think Q4, we will be exceeding 15,000. That's the plan.

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin FY27 ~26-27%; FY28 expected ~29-30% as quartz scales
items.quote: EBITDA would be close to 30%, little above 30%. And overall blended EBITDA might be around 29%, 30%.

items.statement: Granite order book supports 10-12% volume growth in FY27; Q4 historically 30-38% of annual revenue due to Chinese New Year
items.quote: I think last year it was 35% of the overall year revenue. So that is also historically constant for us. So this year also I think it will be not be any different.

items.statement: Diesel cost volatility key risk; electrification of fleet and solar back-integration underway to reduce exposure
items.quote: The biggest lever in this is the volume growth, right revenue growth. So if if revenue growth is able to absorb most of the other costs, fixed costs and I think that revenue growth we will be able to meet, we feel as of now.

items.statement: MoU signed with Indonesia's PERMINAS for rare earths (ionic clays, heavy & light); JV formation expected this quarter; first production in 12-15 months post-JV
items.quote: Now this MoU will be translated into an agreement to form a JV along with them and I think you will find developments on that during this quarter which we will update you in the next meeting.

items.statement: Sri Lanka policy finalized; license expected this quarter; ground breaking ~October; plant build 12-15 months; revenue from FY29
items.quote: I think we will can start internally timelines we can start breaking the ground somewhere in October. So I think from that point of time, we should look at 12 to 15 months for the plant build-out and start operations.

items.statement: Kerala JV stalled awaiting new government MD appointment; progress expected next quarter
items.quote: We are hoping that once the new MD and new team comes in place, we will start progressing that and in continuation to that. Now, a timeline on that we frankly cannot estimate, because government thing.

items.statement: Intent to keep operating costs flat in USD terms over coming couple of years; only INR cost changes from currency translation
items.quote: So in dollar terms, our intent would be to keep the employee expenses and the admin expenses flat over the coming couple of years. That would be the intent.

items.statement: Gross profit per unit (yield) at current levels considered sustainable; incremental volume growth directly multiplies gross profit; EBITDA margin % not relevant due to freight pass-through
items.quote: In terms of the gross profit per unit of volume, we believe that the current levels can be sustained. So any incremental growth that you would see in volumes would be a direct multiplier on the gross profit.

items.statement: Sequential volume improvement across trade lanes: LCL and air up ~5% QoQ, FCL up ~1% QoQ; half of growth from market, half from outperformance
items.quote: As an outcome of that, we have seen incremental volumes in both LCL and air of the magnitude of about 5%, while on the FCL, we have seen a quarter-on-quarter growth rate of about 1%.

items.statement: Freight rates elevated due to capacity constraints from geopolitical disruptions; higher rates improve container utilization and FCL margins, boosting absolute gross profit despite pass-through nature
items.quote: The capacity on the carrier side has been somewhat more constrained with all these disruptions. And as an outcome of that, the freight rates prevailing over the last few months have been on the higher side.

items.statement: LCL is highest margin, lowest working capital business with 14.5% global market share; FCL <1% share but higher growth potential from low base; air sits in middle
items.quote: In the addressable market globally we hold about 14.5% market share in LCL. In FCL that number is not even 1%.

items.statement: Business is extremely asset-light; capex investments are tiny fraction of P&L; most depreciation is non-cash from goodwill and acquisitions
items.quote: As a business, it's an extremely asset-light business with hardly any capital assets owned or even the capex investments are a tiny fraction of the company's P&L.

items.statement: No near-term acquisition plans; strategy is organic growth through hiring teams for new markets/products; present in all relevant markets and products
items.quote: At least in the near term, the strategy is to grow by investing in people and not buying businesses.

items.statement: Maintain FY27 revenue growth guidance of 30% and 100% EBITDA improvement
items.quote: To add on here, the annual guidance was 30% revenue improvement and 100% EBITDA improvement remains the same.

items.statement: Offline business targeting near profitability in FY27 with steady-state margin of 13-15%
items.quote: Our clear path to profitability of a steady state of 13% to 15% will largely come in from an ARPU play and improving the outcomes.

items.statement: Online margins improving from 27% in FY26 with further expansion expected in FY27 as new categories break even
items.quote: Last fiscal year we witnessed around 27% margins. As Prateek sir already mentioned, I think path to higher profitability some of these categories UPSC, GATE, Foundation and state boards, we are already seeing that they are approaching towards higher profitability and mature categories like JEE, NEET. So, margins from h

items.statement: Offline Vidyapeeth centers from FY23-24 cohort already delivering 13-15% margins
items.quote: The steady-state margin is 13% to 15% which we are delivering in our '23-'24 centers.

items.statement: NEET exam cycle shift delayed enrollments by 5-7 weeks; offline growth would have been 22-25% vs reported 14%
items.quote: The offline revenue growth that has been witnessed to the tunes of 14% for this quarter y-o-y would have been to the tunes of 22% to 25% had the NEET examination cycle would have sort of been over by 4th of May.

items.statement: Online K-12 enrollments grew 41% YoY to 0.78M; revenue up 88% to INR105 cr
items.quote: It has grown by 40% - 41% enrollment-wise from 0.55 million to 0.78 million. Revenue-wise, it has grown by 88% year-on-year from INR56 crores to INR105 crores.

items.statement: NEET PG enrollments up ~50%, collections up 100% YoY
items.quote: This year we have seen NEET PG enrollments growing approximately by 50% and the collection are growing by 100% in NEET PG.

items.statement: Vernacular enrollments and revenue up 1.7x; state board enrollments and revenue doubled
items.quote: Vernacular, which is a vision to make a pan-India brand, we have 1.7x jump in our enrollments and revenue in vernacular categories. K-12, Alakh already spoke about, like 41% jump in enrollment and 88% jump in our revenue. Along with that, our state board, which is a huge, huge TAM, the enrollments are doubled, so does

items.statement: Online revenue grew 33% YoY; offline grew 16% YoY; online now 33% of total revenue mix
items.quote: Revenue from online grew 33% year-over-year and offline and other businesses grew at 16%.

items.statement: Offline expansion opportunistic and limited; new center planning to be decided over next 2 quarters
items.quote: Our approach to offline expansion will be opportunistic and limited to geographies that fit into our cohort economics. Accordingly, new centers planning would probably get decided over the next 2 quarters.

items.statement: Treasury at INR5,600 cr including INR2,000 cr IPO proceeds; capital allocation focused on online content/categories organic and inorganic
items.quote: As of June 30, our treasury is INR5,600 crores, including IPO proceeds of INR2,000 crores. Like I mentioned last time, our capital allocation will largely be towards new online content and categories, both organic and inorganic.

items.statement: Divesting Finzy Fintech; received interest and signed 2 non-binding term sheets; expect completion in a quarter
items.quote: Along with the capital allocation, we have decided to divest Finzy Fintech and we have already received couple of interest and signed 2 non-binding term sheets. So, probably in a quarter timeline we will be able to achieve this divestment.

items.statement: Pathshala centers reduced from 84 to 70 due to conversion to Vidyapeeth format; zero closures
items.quote: So, zero Pathshala has been closed. Actually those Pathshalas were converted into Vidyapeeth.

items.statement: Gross margin expected in 67%-69% range for FY27; Q3 seasonally strong
items.quote: I would try to kind of keep it in the 67% to 69% zipcode, right, like at least for this year and see where it goes.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin 11.5%, up from 5% YoY and 1.2pp sequentially despite salary increments
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA rose to INR50 crores with a 11.5% margin and PAT was INR34 crores with a 7.5% margin.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month net revenue retention (NRR) reached 125% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: We saw our trailing 12-month net retention, NRR going up to 125%.

items.statement: 10 active AI pilots; major U.S. news network selected Newspulse for AI-first newsroom transformation
items.quote: We have more than 10 active pilots across different customers. And more importantly, we had a major U.S. news network that selected Amagi's Newspulse to transform themselves into an AI-first newsroom.

items.statement: Generated $282K monthly run-rate cloud cost savings in Q1, reinvested into AI initiatives
items.quote: In Q1, we generated about $282,000 of monthly run rate savings in gross margin cloud cost optimization that we've reinvested into the AI-related initiatives.

items.statement: Target adjusted EBITDA breakeven for full year FY27 with profitability expected in H2 FY27
items.quote: We also indicated that we'll try really hard for the entire year to be adjusted EBITDA breakeven in the current year. We also indicated in the last call that given the seasonality in the business, some of this profitability should come in the second half of the current financial year.

items.statement: Expect corporate overheads to decline to 7-8% of revenue over next 4-5 years from current 22%
items.quote: Our corporate overheads continue to reduce and we expect over the next four to five years for it to come below to 7-8%.

items.statement: Service EBITDA margin expanded to ~13% in Q1 FY27 from ~10% in Q1 FY26, driven by renewal book growth and operating leverage
items.quote: In Q1 FY27, service EBITDA has grown at nearly 90% to reach INR 39 crores for the quarter. This is approximately 13% of our quarterly revenues.

items.statement: Renewal service EBITDA is 2.5-3x higher than new business service EBITDA due to lower CAC and better insurer terms
items.quote: Renewal from a service EBITDA point of view, if I were to compare renewal service EBITDA to new service EBITDA, renewal service EBITDA is about 2.5 times to 3 times higher than the new service EBITDA.

items.statement: Platform premium grew 49% YoY to INR 1,205 crores in Q1 FY27, with strong growth across motor, health (45%+) and life (60%+)
items.quote: Platform premium for the quarter was INR 1,205 crores, which has grown by 49% YoY.

items.statement: Renewal revenue share increased to 22% of total revenue in Q1 FY27 from 19% in Q1 FY26, growing 66% YoY
items.quote: Renewal revenue last year was 19%. This year, it has gone up to 22% in Q1.

items.statement: Active digital partners (P3M) grew 30-32% YoY to ~90,791, with total DP base at 690,000+ after recruiting 32,000+ in Q1
items.quote: Our P3M Active base, meaning rolling 90-day active, were just above 90,000 active digital partners for the quarter, which was a growth of about 30% YoY.

items.statement: DP attrition stable: 28-30% in first 24 months, then 2-3% annually, with ~65% retention at year 5-6
items.quote: Basically, over the years, we know that in the first 18 months, there is a learning curve. And you see some attrition of about 28 -30% in the first 24 months. Then the attrition rate drops to 2-3% where basically 95% of the people after 18 months retain on the platform.

items.statement: Claims servicing handled INR 26+ crores in Q1 with 1.5 lakh+ service requests, building trust and differentiation
items.quote: During Q1, we helped policyholders settle claims amounting to more than INR 26 crores, there would have been some complexity delay or rejection. We handled around 1.5 lakh plus unique servicing requests during this quarter.

items.statement: Management expects 35% top-line and EBITDA growth in FY27 vs FY26, with similar growth continuing in FY28 and FY29
items.quote: I think we're expecting 35% growth in our top line in this financial year. And similarly, EBITDA also, we'll see the same growth coming up in this financial year as compared to last financial year.

items.statement: Normalized EBITDA margin of 14%+ seen as achievable for FY27, with potential for better if geopolitical conditions remain favorable
items.quote: As of now, what we can perceive that, that will happen. But if things remain as good as they are currently and no untoward incident happens on the geopolitical front, we'll give you better results than this.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 normalized EBITDA margin 15.5% (up 480bps YoY); overseas ops contributed 91% of incremental EBITDA; management confident margins sustainable for next 3 years
items.quote: Normalized EBITDA post adjustment of Rs. 825 million on forex derivative transactions reached Rs. 8,373 million, which is 78% growth year-on-year, expanded to 15.5%. Our overseas operations contributed around 91% of the Rs. 4,410 million incremental EBITDA.

items.statement: BOPP prices up 25-32%, BOPET up 30-35% since Feb 2026 due to West Asia crisis; raw material costs rising but less than finished goods; pricing seen as stable at current levels while crisis persists
items.quote: BOPP prices have gone up by 25%, and BOPET prices have gone up by almost 30%-35% from, to be specific from February '26 level to now, it is 25-32% higher on BOPP and BOPET rate is around 30-35% higher.

items.statement: Strategic shift to value-added products driving margin expansion; 60-70% of future capex to value-added verticals (Aseptic, WPP, recycling); Aseptic expected to rebound from Q3 with Egypt plant adding ~2B packs in FY27
items.quote: We are moving from normal films to value-added products, which can give us a better realization, so those are being done very aggressively now. From Q3 onwards, you see Aseptic coming back on track.

items.statement: West Asia crisis (Bab-el-Mandeb) creating supply chain disruptions but UFlex's derisked multi-geography model (local-for-local) mitigates impact; duty-free Aseptic imports from Indonesia pressuring India volumes
items.quote: We are running a derisked model now. India caters to mostly India demands and other areas cater to other areas demand. Somebody who is dependent on Indian export only will have a difficulty in supplying the material. But we have all across geographies and are fully integrated.

items.statement: Revenue growth expected around 20% for FY27, higher than previous 12% guidance
items.quote: See, 27% is obviously very good growth, but we expect the revenue growth to be in the range close to 20%, right, much better than the 12% guidance we had given earlier, around 20% something.

items.statement: Capex of INR 170-180 crore planned for FY27, part of INR 500 crore total capex largely completing by FY28
items.quote: it's largely this year, we are expecting to have a capex of about INR170 - 180 crores at least in the current financial year.

items.statement: INR 500 crore total capex largely completing by FY28, with some spillover possible to FY29
items.quote: Largely, if you look at FY basis, largely it would be over by FY28. Maybe some part could spill down to FY29, but largely it will be over by FY28.

items.statement: Commodity inflation pass-through to OEMs is work in progress with 1-2 quarter lag; exact numbers not disclosed
items.quote: On price and commodity inflation, if you see our OEM contracts usually have a clause around the commodity inflation linked to the index in which we keep working along with the OEMs. And even currently, it's the work in progress for the recent round of commodity inflation.

items.statement: Vehicle aftermarket volumes slightly declined; focus on protecting margins and recovering volumes in next 5 months
items.quote: So vehicle aftermarket business has a certain different set of challenges. So far, it's kind of plateau or a small decline in our revenue. The next 5 months, we have some different strategy to cover up or recover our volume.

items.statement: OEM mix: 2-wheeler 54%, passenger vehicle 31%, commercial vehicle 15% in Q1 FY27

items.quote: Shipway operates in courier aggregation, which is a large market opportunity. As per our estimates, it's INR4,000 crores plus market, where we are a relatively early-stage player, single-digit market share today.

items.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to FY26 levels.

items.quote: We intend to deploy a significant majority of these net proceeds within this fiscal year, primarily towards high-quality inorganic opportunities and also towards select organic growth initiatives.

items.statement: Renewable energy order for sheet metal assemblies supporting 2.5 GW annual supply, production starting Q4 FY27, peak revenue >INR1,500 million
items.quote: At peak volumes, the facility is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR1,500 million.

items.quote: The program is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR650 million and will be added to our existing brownfield facility in Bangalore, with start of production expected in Q4 of this fiscal year.

items.quote: We have been selected to manufacture 59 unique assemblies as part of their localization program for one of their highest-selling EV models.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin ~81% (within guided range); EBITDA margin 35.8% moderated due to pre-operating costs for new outlets at Noida, Cochin, Delhi
items.quote: Adjusting for this reclassification of INR223 million of lounge aggregation cost from other expenses to cost of sales, the adjusted gross profit stands at INR3.65 billion, translating into an adjusted gross profit margin of around 81%, which remains well within our guided range.

items.statement: Net contract gains of 15.9% system-wide YoY; historically in 15-16% ballpark but lumpy year-to-year
items.quote: We sustained strong momentum in new outlet openings, backed by recent contract wins and a robust pipeline, which translated into net contract gains of 15.9% year-on-year at the system-wide level.

items.statement: Launched passenger services (meet-and-greet, porter) at Noida under Elite Assist brand; integrating into EATS tech platform for cross-selling
items.quote: Another important milestone during the quarter was the successful launch of our passenger services at Noida International Airport under our Elite Assist brand, including meet-and-greet and porter services.

items.statement: Debt-free balance sheet with INR9.7B cash as of June 30; provides headroom for airport expansions, lounges, highways, passenger services
items.quote: As of June 30th, we maintain a debt-free balance sheet and a consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion.

items.statement: International expansion focus shifting to Asia (Indonesia entity set up) while Middle East normalizes; Dubai entity established for Middle East opportunities
items.quote: We have set up an entity in Dubai to focus at the region. We set up another entity recently in Indonesia to look at opportunities there because you need those local entities to be able to bid for opportunities in the markets.

items.statement: Targeted turnover for FY27 is INR 850 crore and for FY28 is INR 1,200 crore
items.quote: Sir, targeted turnover for the FY26-27 is almost INR 850 crores and for FY27-28 is INR 1,200 crores.

items.statement: Total work order including recent toll wins is INR 900 crore (EPC ~INR 500 crore, toll ~INR 400 crore)
items.quote: Recently we secured INR 120 crores new toll projects in Tamil Nadu. And so, adding this, we have INR 900 crores of work order, out of which EPC is almost INR 500 crores and the rest for toll segment.

items.statement: Traffic trends improving and near normal levels after geopolitical disruptions impacted Moti Naroli toll plaza in Q1
items.quote: And you can also see it on the IHMCL website. So, naturally, we are almost near normal to what the earlier traffic was.

items.statement: EBITDA margin drop in Q1 due to geopolitical factors; recovery expected if no new developments
items.quote: Yes, I think so. And even so, I think there was a drop in our EBITDA margin recently because of this geopolitical situation recently. And so, going forward, I think, and if there are no new developments on that front, we should be good.

items.statement: Voluntary surrender of a toll project with unfavorable economics due to geopolitical disruptions
items.quote: A temporary bidding restriction from NHAI and the voluntary surrender of a toll project where economics had been unfavorable due to the same reason.

items.statement: Current weakness from geopolitical factors will not significantly impact full-year results; recovery in H2 as per seasonal trend
items.quote: Actually, this won't have a significant impact on the full-year results because, based on past trends, we tend to hover around the break-even point during the first and second quarters, while seeing a rapid recovery in the third and fourth quarters.

items.statement: FY27 maize crushing target above 400,000 tons vs 265,000 tons in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting that the crushing will go up above 4,00,000 tons in the entire year.

items.statement: Value-added products expected to reach 20-22% of turnover in FY27 from 3% in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting it to go up to 20 %-22% of our entire turnover as value -added products.

items.statement: Major capex cycle substantially complete; Rs 552 crore spent of Rs 664 crore total outlay by June 2026
items.quote: Of the total project outlay of approximately Rs. 664 crores, around Rs. 552 crores had been incurred as of 30 June 2026, with the major phase of CAPEX cycle now substantially behind us.

items.statement: Value-added margin expanded to 39.8% in Q1 FY27 from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 driven by shift to manufacturing-led revenue
items.quote: Value-added grew 30.3% year -on-year to Rs. 80.53 crores, with value -added margin expanded to 39.8% from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 , driven by a decisive shift towards higher margin, manufacturing led revenue.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 540 bps to 15.3% in Q1 FY27; PAT margin improved 291 bps to 6.6%
items.quote: The operating EBITDA rose 26.6% year -on-year to Rs . 30.98 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding 540 basis points to 15.3%. The profit after tax grew 47% year -on-year to Rs. 13.33 crores and PAT margin improved 291 basis points to 6.6%.

items.statement: Export contribution doubled to 10.4% in Q1 FY27 from 4.9% in Q1 FY26; targeting further geographic diversification
items.quote: Contribution from exports more than doubled to 10.4% in quarter 1 '27 from 4.9% in quarter 1 '26, reflecting growing acceptance of our products across international markets.

items.statement: New value-added products include Liquid Glucose (180 TPD), Maltodextrin (50 TPD); Modified starches and Dextrose variants planned for FY27
items.quote: During FY'27, we plan to enter high value derivatives including Dextrose Anhydrous, Dextrose Monohydrate and Hydrol , while expanding beyond our existing Dextrin and edible starch range into specialized modified starches such as cationic starch, carboxy methyl starch, pre-gel starch and spray starch.

items.statement: Net debt Rs 735.32 crore; peak debt in H1 FY27, expected to decline in H2 as working capital normalizes
items.quote: Our working capital requirement is highest in the H1. So, that's why the debt is peaking. And definitely, it is going to come down when the H2 comes.

items.statement: Long-term value-added capacity mix designed at 50:50 starch:value-added; FY28 turnover mix guided at 30-35% value-added
items.quote: Capacity, so automatically 35% will happen. Turnover automatically 30%-35%. Total turnover.

items.statement: Target to cross INR500 crores consolidated revenue in FY27 with 12-15% growth
items.quote: We continue to work towards our stated objective of crossing INR500 crores in consolidated revenue during the FY 27, while maintaining appropriate discipline on margins and working capital.

items.statement: Received Reliance Group orders worth INR45.71 crores, Nesco INR1.94 crores, West Bengal Secretariat INR36.71 lakhs in Q1 FY27
items.quote: We received 5 work orders from Reliance Projects and Property Management Services worth INR30.77 crores for housekeeping, MEP electrical, and ancillary services. In addition, we secured facility management contracts across 7 Reliance Group entities valued at INR14.94 crores, taking the combined value of orders from the

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 121 bps to 7.99%; management expects 1-2% EBITDA margin improvement over next 2 years from technology mix shift
items.quote: I would expect at least an increase of about 1% to 2% in the EBITDA area over the next 2 years or so.

items.statement: Wage hikes passed to clients with 3-month DSO lag; temporary working capital impact
items.quote: Yes, so we of course give the wages first and then we raise a bill on the client and then the client pays typically in three months. That is our DSO cycle.

items.statement: INR1 crore investment for HDFC command center setup; skill development centers require capex for labs and training infrastructure
items.quote: The investment, currently the investment that we are looking at is around a INR1 crores to set up the entire control room, wooden wall panels, et cetera.

items.statement: IPO proceeds balance INR36.85 crores as of June 2026; no buyback planned, funds earmarked for growth, skill development capex, working capital
items.quote: Yes so currently as on June 2026 IPO funds which are available is around INR36.85 crores.

items.statement: GeM bidding at 3.85% margin compresses government manpower contracts; CCTV segment loss in Q1 due to project execution timing
items.quote: Government contracts, you are aware in terms of the GeM bidding, nowadays they have brought down the percentage to 3.85%. So at L1 everybody is bidding at 3.85%.

items.statement: Net debt: standalone INR69 crores, consolidated INR82 crores; cash INR60 crores (standalone June); working capital ~90 days; client retention 96-97%
items.quote: At a standalone basis, it is around INR69 crores and on a consolidated basis it is around INR82 crores.

items.statement: Long-term revenue target of INR600-700 crores in 2-3 years with healthier profitability
items.quote: I believe that INR600 crores to INR700 crores figure long-term revenue targets are still in place.

items.statement: Expect meaningful improvement in returns from strategic investments in 3-6 quarters
items.quote: So, the answer would be in 3 quarters to 6 quarters I think we can start seeing results of these strategic investments.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT declined to INR2.2 crores from INR6.51 crores YoY due to higher freight and employee costs
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, PBT stood at INR3.04 crores compared with INR7.26 crores, and PAT stood at INR2.2 crores compared with INR6.51 crores.

items.statement: Shipping costs increased significantly; company absorbing partial hit while passing some to purchase and sales prices
items.quote: We are taking the hit, but we are still able to grow on revenue. We are taking partial hit and we are taking -- where we are partially trying to supply, like, pass it on to the suppliers also, like, at the time of purchase, and partially trying to pass it at the time of sales.

items.statement: No fixed capex; investments in inventory, manpower, and marketing are transient and growing quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: All the investments made are transient in nature. None of them are fixed investments or any plant machinery capex purchases, etcetera, which has a certain timeline of 3-year break even or whatever.

items.statement: Inventory conversion cycle runs over 2 quarters; INR96.8 crores consolidated inventory as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our consolidated inventory stood at about INR96.8 crores, with around INR84.4 crores positioned at our overseas subsidiaries.

items.statement: Target equal revenue mix across new customized equipment, used/refurbished equipment, and HexL in 2-3 years
items.quote: I think if all the three verticals are equal in our revenue mix, I think we would be happy enough.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments increasing freight/logistics costs and elongating shipping times and working capital cycles
items.quote: The ongoing geopolitical developments across various regions have continued to create operational and logistical challenges, particularly for the businesses with significant international exposure, such as ours.

items.statement: Employee benefit expenses rose to INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores YoY to build international sales and operations team
items.quote: Consolidated employee benefit expenses increased to approximately INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance revised up from 50% to 70% YoY for FY27, with potential to trail higher in coming quarters
items.quote: So, we would like to revise our guidance for the full year to 70% considering the robust demand which is there and the capacities that we are ready with in Ratlam. And we would like to also highlight one thing that we can trail this guidance in the coming quarters as the year progress.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at sustainable to improve from current 18.9% level for FY27
items.quote: So, I'd like to reiterate that point only. So, we will continue our margin guidance from sustainable to improve for the year. So, we have reported a 18.9% margin, so we continue that guidance.

items.statement: Cumulative gross block including CWIP expected to reach Rs 1,300 crore by end of FY27 from Rs 800 crore at start of year
items.quote: On the capex front, ma'am. When we start this year, we were close to 800 including CWIP and we are by the end of this year, it will be close to 1.300.

items.statement: Channel partner network expanded to 10,100+ (80+ distributors, 1,000+ dealers, 30+ exclusive Shoppes added in Q1); target 15,000+ by end of FY28
items.quote: At the end of 28, we believe more than 15,000 Network partaers including Shoppe? Including Shoppe, dealer and distributor, 15,000.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin of 5-6% reaffirmed
items.quote: We remain aligned with the FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin in the range of 5% to 6%.

items.statement: Order book visibility at INR3,400 crore across confirmed POs, signed MSAs, and advanced discussions
items.quote: On order book visibility, currently stands at approximately INR3,400 crore.

items.statement: Executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for execution by December 31, 2026
items.quote: Together, these orders represent an executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for the execution by the December 31st, 2026.

items.statement: Cell line capex revised to INR1,050 crore (INR700 crore debt, INR350 crore equity) for 2.2 GW first phase
items.quote: At present, INR1,050 crore, out of which INR700 crore from the principal lenders and INR350 crore will be our margin.

items.statement: 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027
items.quote: The 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line, which is the first phase of our planned 5 GW cell capacity, is on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 16.4% YoY; PAT margin 3.1% due to seasonally softer volumes and full quarter depreciation/interest impact
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR33.8 crore as against the INR42.7 crore in Q1 FY26, translating into an EBITDA margin of 12.7% for the quarter as compared to 16.4% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: H2-weighted execution expected; order conversions accelerating post-monsoon with ALMM clarity
items.quote: The situation will be improved once the monsoon gets over and then there will be a lot of pressure in execution of projects and delivery of modules for both the segments.

items.statement: FY27 module utilization assumption 55% (down from ~70% in FY26) due to industry disruption and cell supply constraints
items.quote: For FY27, we are working with an average utilization assumption of around 55% across the year.

items.statement: ALMM-2 caused temporary delivery rescheduling but no order cancellations; domestic cell supply arrangements in place for DCR orders
items.quote: These are the timing shifts and not cancellations. We do not currently see any orders at risk and whether ALMM is extended at any stage or not, there is no impact on our order book.

items.statement: Cell line funding: INR700 crore debt at advanced stage, INR350 crore equity (NCDs/CCDs) in due diligence
items.quote: On funding, the debt component of approximately INR700 crore is at an advanced stage of discussion with our lender, and the equity component of INR350 crore structured as a combination of NCDs and CCDs is progressing through the due diligence stage.

items.statement: BSE listing completed (existing shares, no fresh capital); shareholder base 11,000+
items.quote: Solex Energy is now listed on both the NSE and the BSE. Kindly note, this was a listing of existing shares on the BSE main board. No fresh capital was raised.

items.statement: Indian TOPCon cell cost higher than imported Chinese cells; DCR tenders priced accordingly
items.quote: Those tenders which are already bidded with the domestic cells are bidded with the higher price considering the high cost of cell. The Indian cell cost will be higher compared to the imported right now.

items.statement: Vision 2030: 10 GW module, 10 GW cell, 10 GW BESS, 2 GW wafer/ingot; INR4,000 crore Gujarat MoU signed
items.quote: The INR4,000 crore MoU we have signed with the Government of Gujarat is the first concrete step in that direction.

items.statement: Management expects sustainable good earnings for next 6 to 8 quarters on favorable BOPET supply-demand.
items.quote: So , all this give us confidence that we should have sustainable good earnings going forward, not only for the next 3 quarters, but I would go on to say, for next 6 to 8 quarters.

items.statement: Company expects to reach INR2,000-2,200 crore revenue in next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Yes. I think we are steadily marching towards that, and we should definitely be hitting there in next 2 years to 3 years.

items.statement: Targeting VAS products at 50-60% of film volumes over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Encouraged by the recent performance and positive outcomes of our strategic focus, we are targeting proportion of VAS products at about 50% to 60% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: VAS contribution expected up to 35% of portfolio by exit quarter this fiscal.
items.quote: See, we are seeing up to 35% contribution of VAS product out of our own -- up to the overall portfolio by the quarter end, I mean, in the exit quarter.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers targeting 20% CAGR over next 3-5 years; FY27 flat to single-digit growth.
items.quote: We are targeting growth at a CAGR of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years in the Specialty Polymer segment.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers revenue growth expected to recover by end of this financial year.
items.quote: However, given the strength of our business development pipeline, we expect to recover the revenue growth in this business by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers EBIT margin may moderate in percentage terms but absolute EBITDA/EBIT to grow.
items.quote: But you are right. As we go forward, we are g oing to see some moderation of the percentage margins, right? Because the mid-margin is going to pull down the high specialty margins a little bit in percentage terms.

items.statement: 12-micron commodity film spreads were INR28-30 last quarter and are holding resilient.
items.quote: So, spreads last quarter were in the range of INR28 to INR30. When I say spread, I mean VA, value-add over raw material for 12-micron film.

items.statement: BOPET supply-demand balance expected to hold for next 6-8 quarters, keeping margins steady.
items.quote: See, like I told you that we are very positive that for next 6 quarters to 8 quarters, the global and domestic supply-demand balance is going to hold. And I think that is going to give us some respite and is going to keep the margin steady.

items.statement: Only 2-3 new BOPET lines expected in next 1.5-2 years; demand growth outpacing capacity.
items.quote: We are expecting another 2 to 3 lines coming up in the next 1.5 to 2 years.

items.statement: No major capex planned apart from sustenance and maintenance capex.
items.quote: No. So, apart from our sustenance and maintenance capex, we are not planning any major capex.

items.statement: Debt repayment target of INR100 crores this year; gross debt to fall to INR620 crores.
items.quote: So, this year, the debt repayment target is around INR100 crores.

items.statement: ELITe JV to raise additional debt in JV company, not on Ester balance sheet; not consolidated.
items.quote: So, there is going to be additional debt, which will be raised in the JV company, not in Ester balance sheet.

items.statement: ELITe facility targeted operational in CY2028; land acquisition to conclude in 2 months.
items.quote: The facility is targeted to become operational in CY 2028 and will use Loop's proprietary depolymerization technology to convert 100% textile waste streams into virgin -quality monomers, which will then be polymerized into virgin-quality polyester resin.

items.statement: Expects FMCG revenue to cross INR12,500 crores in FY27, up from INR11,000+ crores in FY26
items.quote: Last year our total sales from overall FMCG including the HPC was INR11,000 crores plus, and this year my estimation is that we should certainly cross increase it by 10% plus and we should be somewhere closer to INR12,500 crores in our revenues.

items.statement: TSP EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 16-18% for the year
items.quote: We are quite confident that we will continue the guidance that we have always given that our margins will be 16% to 18% on the TSP. I think we will be able to maintain that.

items.statement: Edible oil EBITDA margin construct guided between 3-5% volume growth, aiming for consistent 5%+ margins
items.quote: How do we increase our margin construct typically what we say between 2% and 4% towards consistently 5-plus percent will be a big driver of growth.

items.statement: Staples volume grew 5% with 12% pricing inflation in Q1 FY27; rural demand caution flagged for current quarter
items.quote: The volumes have grown by 5% and the pricing inflation that came in was almost about 12%.

items.statement: E-commerce and quick commerce revenue contribution at 15% currently, targeting 20% within 18 months
items.quote: Currently, if I were to put those numbers together, we right now do close to about 15% between modern trade and e-commerce, quick commerce. We want to take that number up to 20%.

items.statement: Oil palm cultivated area 1,15,861 hectares as of June 2026, 37% in prime yielding phase (7-25 years)
items.quote: As of 30th June '26, the cultivated area stood at 1,15,861 hectares with nearly 37% of the area in the prime yielding phase of 7 to 25 years, against total allocated area of 6.63 lakh hectares.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases in edible oils; targeted discounts and smaller pack sizes in FMCG to remain competitive
items.quote: We took calibrated price increases in the edible oil segment while using targeted discounts in our FMCG portfolio to remain competitive. We also introduced smaller pack sizes to address changing consumer needs and market requirements.

items.statement: HPC acquisition (INR1,100 crores slump sale) generated INR600 crores EBITDA last year; already repaid acquisition cost
items.quote: It was generating a margin of INR600 crores, and we have paid INR1,100 crores which is less than 18, 19 months of profitability and which has already in last 18 months it has already repaid that much and built up assets substantially.

items.statement: Revenue guidance of Rs 300 crore for FY27 reaffirmed; Q1 FY27 revenue at Rs 60.95 crore, balance order book of Rs 150 crore to be executed this year plus pipeline orders by March
items.quote: Sir we have done already 60 in Q1. And the balance about 150 crores, the order book that also needs to be finished in this financial year. And definitely there are some orders in pipeline which also we would need to do it by March. So 300 we are in line Sir.

items.statement: Fabrication capacity being expanded from ~6,000 tons to 18,000 tons/year (1,500 tons/month) at Tedesra Unit for power sector and fabricated bogies
items.quote: Sir, we would be in a position to do about 1500 tons a month about what the plan is that capacity is 1500 tons a month that is about 18,000 tons. So that is but at the moment what we are doing is about without this capacity expansion we are doing about 6000, from 6000 we want to grade it at least 6000 or 7000, 8000 ton

items.statement: PAT margin target maintained at 15-20% for EPC projects; overall PAT margins expected to improve via niche complex products despite railway/power fabrication at similar margins
items.quote: Anything because of its because of the kind of things that are associated with the EPC project. That is again that I am making the box smaller. If anything less than 15 to 20%, we are not interested. So that is why my box is very small.

items.statement: Strong demand across steel, power, railways, defence, oil & gas, shipbuilding; multiple sectors opening simultaneously with broader opportunity landscape than ever before
items.quote: Across thermal and power, railways, defence, oil and gas, shipbuilding, multiple opportunities have opened for the company at the same time. These opportunities are clearly visible to us.

items.statement: Strategic shift to faster-moving products (railway bogies 30-45 day cycle, power fabrication via RXIL/Invoice Mart at 30-35 days) to reduce operating cycle from ~120 days to 60-70 days by FY28
items.quote: By FY28, we expect an operating cycle with the much more controlled and disciplined working capital structure, with a targeting days of 60 to 70 days.

items.statement: Defence revenue share targeted at 5-10% in FY27 and 10-15% in FY28 (including shipbuilding); collaborating with ordnance factories (e.g., Gun Carriage Factory Jabalpur) for hardware/components using flexible machining
items.quote: It will be 5 to 10% because I would add the shipbuilding to the same. So it will be 10 to 15% and it will continue to be 10 to 15% in the next financial year also.

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 revenue growth guidance, stating it would not be prudent to give a number at this time.
items.quote: I don't think it will be prudent to give you any number at this time.

items.statement: Russia licensing arrangement for Exblifep has estimated 10-year value of approximately USD178 million.
items.quote: In Russia, the estimated 10-year value of our licensing arrangement is approximately USD178 million.

items.statement: 7-ACA pricing stable at weighted average ~USD60 for last 10-12 years; limited room for drastic price reduction by Chinese suppliers.
items.quote: The pricing in 7-ACA has been stable over the last 10 to 12 years. The weighted average is about USD60. So, we believe that there is not much room to reduce prices drastically.

items.statement: Regulated market demand typically stronger in H2 (winter season); Q1 FY27 described as mediocre for regulated products.
items.quote: last year trend, we have seen that the second half is generally having more demand from the regulated. It's probably the winter season there.

items.statement: 7-ACA project ramp-up uncertain; guided 12 months to full utilization but may take longer per Aurobindo experience.
items.quote: We've guiding 12 months, but you know -- and I have said that again earlier that Aurobindo looking at other experience, it might be longer.

items.statement: Cefixime margins under maximum stress in rest-of-world markets due to pricing pressure.
items.quote: Cefixime as a product is under maximum stress with respect to margins.

items.statement: 7-ACA commercial batch target March 2027; ramp-up to 80-100% utilization by end of first year; long-term split 80% captive, 20% third-party sales.
items.quote: Our ramp-up plan is to go to about 80% to 100% by the end of the first year. Initially, it would be slow and then increasing progressively. With respect to utilization, our long-term guidance on this is 80% in-house use and 20% selling to third party.

items.statement: Cefiderocol facility commissioning target December 2026; validation and initial batches Jan-Mar 2027; commercial launch subject to DCGI approval.
items.quote: We target commissioning by December of '26, followed by validation and initial batches during January to March '27 period. Commercial launch will be subject to the approval process from DCGI.

items.statement: Exblifep Europe volumes grew 300% in Q3 FY26, 170% in Q4 FY26, and 50% in Q1 FY27 quarter-over-quarter.
items.quote: In Europe, the business is growing at a steady manner whilst volumes grew by approximately 300% in Q3 of '26, 170% in Q4 of '26, and about 50% in Q1 of '27.

items.statement: NP-NC segment revenue ~INR21 crores in Q1 FY27; working on new molecules and backward integration.
items.quote: So, this quarter sales was INR21 crores, and we are working on a couple of molecules. We are also planning to scale up and backward integrate in these molecules also.

items.statement: Full-year volume target of 10-12 million tons may see 10% variance, implying 9-11 million tons.
items.quote: As mentioned, we have given a target of 10 to 12 and we expect maybe there may be a 10% variance into this target. So we can consider like a 9 to 11 kind of a range.

items.statement: Confident of achieving or exceeding 15 million tons bauxite volume guidance by FY28.
items.quote: We remain confident in our ability to achieve or even cross our guidance of 15 million tons by financial year ’28.

items.statement: Expects around USD1 billion (~INR10,000 crores) bauxite sales at 15 million tons baseline.
items.quote: So even picking that as a baseline kind of number for the next financial year, we can think that around you know, almost about billion dollars of sales we are expecting from bauxite as per the company's plan.

items.statement: EBITDA per ton expected to stay around USD5.5-6 in next one to two quarters.
items.quote: So around USD6 or USD5.5 to USD6 would be a reasonable, expectation.

items.statement: Medium-to-long term EBITDA per ton expected to return closer to earlier ~USD10 levels.
items.quote: So at least we should able to achieve over a medium to longer term closer to the EBITDAs we were achieving earlier which was near USD10.

items.statement: EBITDA to improve significantly possibly in next calendar year as freight normalizes and quota system kicks in.
items.quote: So, we expect EBITDA to improve significantly from now, maybe in the sort of next calendar year, at least this is our expectation.

items.statement: Planning capex of close to INR200 crores across India business verticals.
items.quote: As stated previously, we are also planning a capex close to INR200 crores across various projects and business verticals.

items.statement: Boffa port capacity enhanced to 8 million tons; GSM new jetty to be operational by Q4 FY27 raising capacity to 10 MT.
items.quote: At GSM, the second port, the new jetty is currently under construction and expected to be operational by Q4 of this financial year, increasing capacity from 6 million tons to 10 million tons per annum.

items.statement: Combined port capacity to reach approximately 23 million tons supporting medium-term volume growth.
items.quote: With these developments, our combined port capacity will reach to approximately 23 million tons, providing us with the infrastructure to support the maximized volume growth and sales over the medium terms.

items.statement: Bauxite washing plant of 20,000 tons per day set up; expansion would take about one year if decided.
items.quote: I think the fundamental purpose of bauxite washing plant might be EBITDA neutral but it definitely helps us to increase our total volume and throughput which we can do from a particular location because it makes the more low grade resources into high grade and exportable resources.

items.statement: Guinea bauxite export quota system expected before end of this year, seen as positive for prices.
items.quote: We believe this could be introduced in the near terms and certainly before end of this year.

items.statement: Realizations to remain close to similar levels until quota system provides directional tailwind.
items.quote: I think that the realizations may remain close to similar levels for time being until we have -- I think any kind of directional tailwind would probably come in from the quota system.

items.statement: Four new Chinese refineries expected to add 20-30 million tons bauxite demand over current volumes.
items.quote: Several new refineries are coming on stream, including the four new refineries in China which are expected to create additional bauxite demand of around 20 million tons to 30 million tons over the above current volumes.

items.statement: Freight rates highly volatile; expects volatility to continue across 2027, pressuring margins.
items.quote: The freight rates remains highly volatile. Given the current geopolitical environments, we expect this volatility to continue across 2027.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 expected to produce around 500 wagons versus 300-odd wagons in Q1.
items.quote: We hope to do around 500 wagons in the quarter as compared to 300 and odd wagons in the first quarter.

items.statement: Wagon manufacturing to grow about 45-50%, other businesses 8-10%.
items.quote: whereas the wagon manufacturing would show a growth of approximately more than 45% to 50%.

items.statement: Targets 15-17% EBITDA margin for freight wagon business over medium term.
